text: N lunesc à n valgun scienziac dl'Università de Stanford lascià al savëi che l unirà ora n strumënt dianiostich nuef che ie bon de mëter ju la zeles aldò dla sort: drët n pitl chip che possa unì stampà cun stampantes a tinta per l priesc de zirca 1 n centejim de dolar l un.
eng_text: On Monday, scientists from the Stanford University School of Medicine announced the invention of a new diagnostic tool that can sort cells by type: a tiny printable chip that can be manufactured using standard inkjet printers for possibly about one U.S. cent each.

text: I scienziac plu renumei dij che chësc pudëssa purté al recunescimënt bunerif dl crëibes, dl melsëch, dl HIV y dla malaria per i amalei che viv te stac ulache n davania puech y ulache la zifres de chëi che sëuraviv la malaties sciche l crëibes al piet ie mé mez tan autes coche ti stac plu rics.
eng_text: Lead researchers say this may bring early detection of cancer, tuberculosis, HIV and malaria to patients in low-income countries, where the survival rates for illnesses such as breast cancer can be half those of richer countries.

text: L Gripen JAS 39C ie tumà ju sun la pista da dé sëura ntëur la 9:30 aldò dl orar dl post (02:30 UTC) y ie sautà tl aier, nsci che l aeroport à messù unì stlut per i joi cumerziei.
eng_text: The JAS 39C Gripen crashed onto a runway at around 9:30 am local time (0230 UTC) and exploded, closing the airport to commercial flights.

text: L pilot ie unì identificà coche l cumandant de cumpania Dilokrit Pattavee.
eng_text: The pilot was identified as Squadron Leader Dilokrit Pattavee.

text: Media dl post dij che n auto di destudafuech se à drusà ntan l servisc de prim aiut.
eng_text: Local media reports an airport fire vehicle rolled over while responding.

text: Vidal, de 28 ani, fova unì dan 3 sajons da Sevilla a Barça
eng_text: 28-year-old Vidal had joined Barça three seasons ago, from Sevilla.

text: Da si trasferimënt tla capitela catalana à Vidal fat 49 partides per chëla scuadra.
eng_text: Since moving to the Catalan-capital, Vidal had played 49 games for the club.

text: La prutesta à metù man dala 11:00 aldò dl orar dl post (UTC +1) a Whitehall vis-à-vis dala ntreda cuntroleda dala polizai de vieres dla Downing Street, la residënza ufiziela dl prim minister.
eng_text: The protest started around 11:00 local time (UTC+1) on Whitehall opposite the police-guarded entrance to Downing Street, the Prime Minister's official residence.

text: Puech do la 11:00 à i demustranc blucà l trafich de auti tla direzion nord a Whitehall.
eng_text: Just after 11:00, protesters blocked traffic on the northbound carriage in Whitehall.

text: Dala 11:20 à la polizai pertendù dai demustranc che i vede inò zeruch sun i tretuares y à detlarà che l dërt de prutesta ie da balanzé ora cun l aumënt dl muvimënt di auti.
eng_text: At 11:20, the police asked the protesters to move back on to the pavement, stating that they needed to balance the right to protest with the traffic building up.

text: Ntëur la 11:29 se à la prutesta muet de vieres de Whitehall, passan via per l Trafalgar Square, jan inant per la streda Strand, passan via per Aldwych y su per l Kingsway nchin Holborn, ulache l partit cunservatif teniva si forum da d'ansciuda tl hotel Grand Connaught Rooms.
eng_text: Around 11:29, the protest moved up Whitehall, past Trafalgar Square, along the Strand, passing by Aldwych and up Kingsway towards Holborn where the Conservative Party were holding their Spring Forum in the Grand Connaught Rooms hotel.

text: L record de Nadal tl cunfront ndrët contra l canadesc ie de 7:2.
eng_text: Nadal's head to head record against the Canadian is 7–2.

text: Dan da puech al perdù contra Roanic pra l Brisbane Open.
eng_text: He recently lost against Raonic in the Brisbane Open.

text: Nadal à arjont 88% di ponc netto ntan la partida y à venciù 76 ponc a bater l prim iede.
eng_text: Nadal bagged 88% net points in the match winning 76 points in the first serve.

text: Do la partida à l rë dla plazes cun sablon dit: "Son propi cuntënt de vester ruvà inò zeruch tla fineles di turnoies plu mpurtanc. Son tlo ajache ue purvé de i vëncer."
eng_text: After the match, King of Clay said, "I am just excited about being back in the final rounds of the most important events. I am here to try to win this."

text: "Panama papers" ie l inuem che ti vën dat a ntëur a diesc milions de documënc de n studio de aucac dl Panama Mossack Fonseca che ti ie fac avëi ala stampa d'ansciuda dl 2006.
eng_text: "Panama Papers" is an umbrella term for roughly ten million documents from Panamanian law firm Mossack Fonseca, leaked to the press in spring 2016.

text: I documënc à mustrà su coche catordesc banches ti à judà a tlienc rics a ascuender bilions de dolars de richëzes per schivé de messëi paië chëutes y d'autri duvieres.
eng_text: The documents showed fourteen banks helped wealthy clients hide billions of US dollars of wealth to avoid taxes and other regulations.

text: La zaita dla Gran Bretania The Guardian dà da ntënder che la Deutsche Bank cuntrolova belau n terz dla firmes finta che ie unides metudes su per arjonjes chësc fin.
eng_text: British newspaper The Guardian suggested Deutsche Bank controlled roughly a third of the 1200 shell companies used to accomplish this.

text: L ie unì ora prutestes sëura dut l mond, de plu pruzedimënc penai y i prim ministri dl'Islanda y dl Pakistan à tramedoi dat la demiscions.
eng_text: There were protests worldwide, several criminal prosecutions, and the leaders of the governments of Iceland and Pakistan both resigned.

text: Ma ie nasciù a Hong Kong y à studià tla New York University y tla Harvard Law School y ova tl passà na "green card" americana per residënc permanënc.
eng_text: Born in Hong Kong, Ma studied at New York University and Harvard Law School and once held an American permanent resident "green card".

text: Hsieh dà da ntënder ntan la veles che Ma pudëssa se n mucé oradecà ntan n tëmp de crisa.
eng_text: Hsieh implied during the election that Ma might flee the country during a time of crisis.

text: Hsieh à nce dit che l vester fotogenich de Ma fova plu na cuestion de stil che no de sustanza.
eng_text: Hsieh also argued that the photogenic Ma was more style than substance.

text: Nce sce l tie unì trat dant chësc à Ma venciù zënza problems sun na plataforma che se à dat ca per liams plu strënc cun la tierafërma cineja.
eng_text: Despite these accusations, Ma won handily on a platform advocating closer ties with the Chinese mainland.

text: L jugadëur dl di de ncuei ie Alex Ovechkin di Washington Capitals.
eng_text: Today's Player of the Day is Alex Ovechkin of the Washington Capitals.

text: L à fat 2 goi y 2 assisć tla partida vënta dai Washingtons per 5:3 contra i Atlanta Thrashers.
eng_text: He had 2 goals and 2 assists in Washington's 5-3 win over the Atlanta Thrashers.

text: L prim assist dla sëira de Ovechkin fova chël pra l gol dl debutant Nicklas Backstrom tres chël che n a venciù la partida;
eng_text: Ovechkin's first assist of the night was on the game-winning goal by rookie Nicklas Backstrom;

text: si segondo gol dla sëira fova si 60ejim dla sajon, nsci iel deventà l prim jugadëur che à fat 60 o de plu goi te una na sajon dal 1995-96, canche Jaromir Jagr y Mario Lemieux ova arjont tramedoi chësc travert.
eng_text: his second goal of the night was his 60th of the season, becoming the first player to score 60 or more goals in a season since 1995-96, when Jaromir Jagr and Mario Lemieux each reached that milestone.

text: Batten fova al 190ejim post sun la lista di 400 americans plu rics dl ann 2008 cun n avëi sciazà de 2,3 bilion $.
eng_text: Batten was ranked 190th on the 2008 400 Richest Americans list with an estimated fortune of $2.3 billion.

text: L à fat la laurea al College of Arts & Sciences dl'Università dla Virginia l ann 1950 y ie stat n dunadëur mpurtant de chësta istituzion.
eng_text: He graduated from the College of Arts & Sciences of the University of Virginia in 1950 and was a significant donor to that institution.

text: Ala perjon irachena de Abu Ghraib ti iel unì dat fuech ntan n temult.
eng_text: Iraq's Abu Ghraib prison has been set alight during a riot.

text: La perjon ie unida cunesciuda do che n ie ruvei sëura sun meladurvanzes sun i perjunieres do che la forzes armedes americanes la à sëurantëut.
eng_text: The jail became notorious after prisoner abuse was discovered there after US forces took over.

text: Piquet Jr. à abù n nzidënt tl Grand Prix de Singapur l ann 2008 riesc do che Fernando Alonso se à fermà abenëura pra n pit stop, fajan unì ora l safety car.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. crashed in the 2008 Singapore Grand Prix just after an early pit stop for Fernando Alonso, bringing out the safety car.

text: Canche i auti dan Alonso ie jic a fé penzin do l safety car, iel stat bon de passé dant la grupa y a vëncer.
eng_text: As the cars ahead of Alonso went in for fuel under the safety car, he moved up the pack to take victory.

text: Piquet Jr. ie unì mandà via do l Grand Prix dl'Ungheria l ann 2009.
eng_text: Piquet Jr. was sacked after the 2009 Hungarian Grand Prix.

text: Avisa dala 8:46 daduman fovel n gran chiet te duta la zità che à senià l mumënt avisa canche l prim jet à tucà l ubietif.
eng_text: At exactly 8:46 a.m. a hush fell across the city, marking the exact moment the first jet struck its target.

text: Doi lumes ie unides metudes su a na maniera che si linëus va de nuet de viers dl ciel.
eng_text: Two beams of light have been rigged up to point skywards overnight.

text: Tl areal vëniel fat su te chësc mumënt 5 crazaciel nueves, cun n zënter de trasport y n parch dla memoria a mez ite.
eng_text: Construction is ongoing for five new skyscrapers at the site, with a transportation center and memorial park in the middle.

text: La show PBSà venciù plu de doi desëines de pesć Emmy y l dura mé manco giut de Sesame Street y Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.
eng_text: The PBS show has more than two-dozen Emmy awards, and its run is shorter only than Sesame Street and Mister Rogers' Neighborhood.

text: Uni trasmiscion dla show se dà ju cun n argumënt de n liber spezifich y trata pona chësc argumënt te de plu stories.
eng_text: Each episode of the show would focus on a theme in a specific book and then explore that theme through multiple stories.

text: Uni show dà nce cunsëies de libri che i mutons dëssa pona jì a ti cialé canche i va te si biblioteches.
eng_text: Each show would also provide recommendations for books that children should look for when they went to their library.

text: John Grant, de WNED Buffalo (la sënta de Reading Rainbow) à dit: "Reading Rainbow ti à nsenià ai mutons percie liejer, .... l amor per l liejer - la show ti à fat uni gola a liejer ai mutons che à tëut ca n liber y à liet.
eng_text: John Grant, from WNED Buffalo (Reading Rainbow's home station) said "Reading Rainbow taught kids why to read,... the love of reading — [the show] encouraged kids to pick up a book and to read."

text: N valguni, danter chisc nce John Grant, ie dla minonga che la mancianza de finanziamënc y i mudamënc tla filosofia dla programazion tla televijion educativa à purtà pro che la serie ie ruveda a na fin.
eng_text: It is believed by some, including John Grant, that both the funding crunch and a shift in the philosophy of educational television programming contributed to ending the series.

text: Aldò di meteorologs messëssa la burasca che ie a zirca 645 mailes (1040 km) a uzidënt dla ijules de Capo Verde se desfanté dan ruvé a manacé raions sun la tierafërma.
eng_text: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text: Fred à al mumënt vënc cun 105 mailes per ëura (165 km/h) y se muev tla direzion nord-vest.
eng_text: Fred currently has winds of 105 miles per hour (165 km/h) and is moving towards the northwest.

text: Fred iel l uregan tropichel plu sterch che n à mei registrà tan a sud y a est tl Atlantich da canche n à la imajes sateliteres y permò l terzo majer uregan registrà a est de 35°E.
eng_text: Fred is the strongest tropical cyclone ever recorded so far south and east in the Atlantic since the advent of satellite imagery, and only the third major hurricane on record east of 35°W.

text: Ai 24 de setëmber dl 1759 à Arthur Guinness firmà n cuntrat d'afit per 9000 ani per la St James' Gate Brewery a Dublin, tl'Irlanda.
eng_text: On September 24, 1759, Arthur Guinness signed a 9,000 year lease for the St James' Gate Brewery in Dublin, Ireland.

text: 250 ani plu tert ie Guinness deventà na firma globela che davania plu de 10 billions de euro (US$14.7 billion) uni ann.
eng_text: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text: Jonny Reid, l copilot dl team A1GP dla Zelanda Nueva à ncuei fat storia a vester l plu aslune a passé legalmënter sëura l puent de 48 ani Auckland Harbour via, tla Zelanda Nueva.
eng_text: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Reid ie stat bon de avisé l auto dla A1GP dla Zelanda Nueva, Black Beauty, cun na velozità de passa 160km/h set iedesc sëura l puent via.
eng_text: Mr Reid managed to drive the New Zealand's A1GP car, Black Beauty at speeds over 160km/h seven times over the bridge.

text: La polizai dla Zelanda Nueva se à fat ert a se nuzé de si radar per udëi tan aslune che Reid ie furnà, davia che Black Beauty ie tan bas y l sëul iede che la ie stata bona de museré Reid ie stat canche l à śarà ite y ie jit ju sota i 160km/h.
eng_text: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text: Ti ultim 3 mënsc ie passa 80 perjunieres zënza na acusa ufiziela lascei jì dala perjon zentrela.
eng_text: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text: D'auril de chëst ann à l giudesc Glynn dat ora na despusizion per ntant contra la istituzion, per druché tres che chëi che ie unii arestei y tenii iló do si arest per passa 24 ëura zënza unii damandei ora da n cumisser dla sunieria vënie lascei jì.
eng_text: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: L cumisser fej ora la cauzion, sce la ti vën cunzeduda y formalisea l'acusa che l ufezier che à arestà à dat inant. L'acusa vën pona scrita ite tl sistem nfurmatich dl stat federel, ulache l ti vën jit do al cajo.
eng_text: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: La nterugazion sënia nce l mumënt da canche l nculpà à l dërt a n pruzedimënt aslune dan sunieria.
eng_text: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text: Peter Costello, l tesorier australian y chëla persona che arà plu dessegur da vester l suzessëur dl prim minister John Howard coche sëurastant dl partit liberel, à dit tler che l ie per n sustëni a na industria nucleèra dl'Australia.
eng_text: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text: Costello à dit che l'Australia dëssa se nuzé dl'energia nutleèra pernanche si produzion porta davani.
eng_text: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text: "Sce la ie da garat economicamënter, daussons la avëi. Ie miene, l ne ie de prinzip deguna obiezion contra l'energia nutleèra" à dit Costello.
eng_text: "If it becomes commercial, we should have it. That is, there's no in-principle objection to nuclear energy" Mr Costello said.

text: Aldò dl'ANSA fova la polizai festidieda pervia de n valguna mazedes te posizions autes, ajache la se temova che les pudova purté a na drëta viera per la suzescion.
eng_text: According to Ansa, "police were concerned by a couple of top-level hits they feared might spark a full-blown war of succession.

text: La Polizai à dit che a cë iel Lo Piccolo, ajache l fova a Palermo la man drëta de Provenzano y si majera esperienza ti à purtà l respet dla generazion plu vedla. Chësta ti stajova do ala politica de Provenzano y cialova de ne dé nia tl uedl ntan che ëi fajova deventé for plu sterscia si rë de pudëi.
eng_text: Police said Lo Piccolo had the upper hand because he had been Provenzano's right-hand man in Palermo and his greater experience won him the respect of the older generation of bosses as they pursued Provenzano's policy of keeping as low as possible while strengthening their power network.

text: Chis boss univa tenii a brëna da Provenzano, canche l ulova finé via la viera fata da Riina contra l Stat che tl ann 1992 ti ova custà la vita ai giudesc antimafia Giovanni Falcone y Paolo Borsellino.
eng_text: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text: L aministradëur generel de Apple Steve Jobbs à descurì l aparat ntan che l ie jit sun paladina y à tëut ora l iPhone dala fuia de si jeans.
eng_text: Apple CEO Steve Jobs unveiled the device by walking onto the stage and taking the iPhone out of his jeans pocket.

text: Ntan si relazion de doi ëura al dit: "Apple nventerà da nuef ncuei l telefon; Ncuei jirons ite tla storia."
eng_text: During his 2 hour speech he stated that "Today Apple is going to reinvent the phone, We are going to make history today".

text: L Brasil ie l majer stat catolich sun l mond y la Dlieja catolica ie stata for contra na legalisazion dl matrimone danter persones dl medem sés sun si tiera.
eng_text: Brazil is the largest Roman Catholic country on Earth, and the Roman Catholic Church has consistently opposed the legalization of same-sex marriage in the country.

text: Tl parlamënt dl Brasil (Congresso Nacional) rejonen da 10 ani incà dla legalisazion y de tel nozes ie al mumënt lascedes pro aldò de na lege mé a Rio Grande do Sul.
eng_text: The National Congress of Brazil has debated legalization for 10 years, and such civil marriages are currently only legal in Rio Grande do Sul.

text: La prima pruposta de lege ie dl'ambolta de n iede de São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. Do vel'mudamënt ie la pruposta de lege śën tla mans de Roberto Jefferson.
eng_text: The original bill was drafted by former mayor of São Paulo, Marta Suplicy. The proposed legislation, after being amended, is now in the hands of Roberto Jefferson.

text: I demustranc spera de abiné adum tres na petizion 1,2 milions de sotscrizions da dé ju pona tl parlamënt de nuvëmber.
eng_text: Protesters hope to collect a petition of 1.2 million signatures to present to the National Congress in November.

text: Per la vitimes dla fufules imubilieres iel unì fat ai 20 de merz na ancunteda tl East Bay Community Law Center, davia che l ie unì ora tlermënter che truepa families chier n aiut giuridich per jì contra la desfratedes.
eng_text: After it became apparent that many families were seeking legal help to fight the evictions, a meeting was held on March 20 at the East Bay Community Law Center for the victims of the housing scam.

text: Canche i fitadins à scumencià a rujené sun cie che l ti ie capità, iel per la majera pert dla families tuchedes stat tler te n colp che Carolyn Wilson de OHA à rubà si cauzion y che la se n ie muceda dala zità.
eng_text: When the tenants started sharing what had occurred to them, most of the families involved suddenly realized that Carolyn Wilson of the OHA had stolen their security deposits, and skipped out of town.

text: Abitanc di Lockwood Gardens miena che mo 40 families o de plu pudëssa vester manacedes da desfratedes, do che i à sapù dala polizai che tl Istitut per l frabiché de Oakland (OHA) vëniel cuntrolà mo cuatieres che pudëssa vester tuchei dla fufules imubilieres.
eng_text: Tenants at Lockwood Gardens believe that there may be another 40 families or more to face eviction, since they learned that OHA police are also investigating other public housing properties in Oakland that may be caught up in the housing scam.

text: La grupa à lascià vester si cunzert tl stadium War-Memorial de Maui a chël che 9000 persones dassova tò pert y se à scusà cun i fan.
eng_text: The band canceled the show at Maui's War Memorial Stadium, which was set to be attended by 9,000 people, and apologized to fans.

text: La firma de managment dla grupa, HK Management Inc., ne à tl prim dit deguna rejon, canche la à desdit ai 20 de setëmber, ma bele l di do ala auzà ora che rejons logistiches ie de gauja.
eng_text: The band's management company, HK Management Inc., gave no initial reason when they canceled on September 20, but blamed logistical reasons by the next day.

text: I aucac grecs cunesciui Sakis Kechagioglou y George Nikolakopoulos ie unii śarei via tla perjon de Aten Korydallus, davia che i ie unii nculpei per coruzion.
eng_text: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text: De cunseguënza iel unì su n gran scandul tl ambient giuridich grech ajache l ie unì a lum ativiteies contra la lege che giudesc, nutares y procuradëures à fat ti ani passei.
eng_text: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text: Dan n valguna enes à l deputat y aucat Petros Mantouvalos dat la demiscions, do la nfurmazions dates tres dal jurnalist Makis Triantafylopoulos ntan si trasmiscion tla televijion che plej dassënn "Zoungla“ pra Alpha TV, davia che cumëmbri de si ufize fova ngatiei te caji de coruzion.
eng_text: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text: Sëuraprò ie l prim giudesc Evangelos Kalousis unì śarà via, davia che l ie de gauja per reac de coruzion y de cumpurtamënc depravei.
eng_text: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text: Roberts se à mé refudà de dì zeche sun canche la vita mët man, na cuestion mpurtanta sce la va dl'etica dl abort, dijan che l ne fossa nia etich fé cumentares sun la particulariteies de caji che possa unì a se l dé.
eng_text: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text: Purempò al cunfermà inò si detlarazion de dant che l cajo de Roe contra Wade ie la "giurisprudënza dl Stat che vel" y auza ora la mpurtanza de sentënzes coerëntes dla Chëurt suprema.
eng_text: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text: L à nce cunfermà che l crëia tl dërt sun la privacy che toca leprò y sun chël che la dezijion se stiza tl cajo Roe.
eng_text: He also confirmed that he believed in the implied right to privacy which the Roe decision depended upon.

text: Maroochydoreà stlut ju a cë dla tlassifica, sies ponc dan Noosa che ie segondo.
eng_text: Maroochydore had finished on top of the ladder, six points clear of Noosa in second.

text: La doi pertes se à ancuntà tla semifinela plu mpurtanta ulache Noosa à batù i averseres cun 11 ponc de vantaje.
eng_text: The two sides would meet in the major semi final where Noosa ran out winners by 11 points.

text: Maroochydore à pona batù Caboolture tla prima finela.
eng_text: Maroochydore then defeated Caboolture in the Preliminary Final.

text: Hesperonychus elizabethae ie na sort dla familia di Dromaeosauridae y ie n jurman di Velociraptor.
eng_text: Hesperonychus elizabethae is a species of the family Dromaeosauridae and is a cousin of Velociraptor .

text: N ratova che chësc ucel de rapina curì dlonch da plumes y dal sanch ciaut jissa bel rëit sun doi giames cun sgrinfles coche i Velociraptor.
eng_text: This fully feathered, warm blooded bird of prey was believed to have walked upright on two legs with claws like the Velociraptor.

text: Si segonda sgrinfla fova majera y n ti à dat perchël l inuem Hesperonychus che uel dì "sgrinfla uzidentela".
eng_text: Its second claw was larger, giving rise to the name Hesperonychus which means "western claw."

text: Sëuraprò ala dlacia che se romp à la cundizions dl tëmp estremes tenì su l'azion de prim aiut.
eng_text: In addition to the crushing ice, extreme weather conditions have been hampering rescue efforts.

text: Pittman ratova che la cundizions ne deventerà nia miëures dan l'ena che vën.
eng_text: Pittman suggested that conditions wouldn't improve until sometime next week.

text: La cuantità y la grussëza dla dlacia che ie tla regions polares ie aldò de Pittman la piecia mei stata ti 15 ani passei per i iagri de foches.
eng_text: The amount and thickness of the pack ice, according to Pittman, is the worst it has been for sealers in the past 15 years.

text: Nuviteies se à sparpanià ora ncuei tla cumenanza de Red Lake ntan la supeltura de Jeff Weise y de mo trëi dla nuef vitimes dijan che mo n studënt ie unì arestà ajache lià al stlupeté te scola di 21 de merz.
eng_text: News spread in the Red Lake community today as funerals for Jeff Weise and three of the nine victims were held that another student was arrested in connection with the school shootings of March 21.

text: Aldò de n stat ulache l vel la regula che chi che vënc giapa dut, ti à la Florida dat la ujes per duc si 50 delegac a Romney y nsci iel ruvà a cë per unì numinà candidat per l partit Republican.
eng_text: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: I urganisadëures dla prutestes à dit che ntëur a 100.000 persones fova leprò tla ziteies tl Deutschland, coche Berlin, Kölln, Hamburg y Hanover.
eng_text: Organisers of the protest said about 100,000 people turned up in German cities such as Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, and Hanover.

text: A Berlin à la polizai sciazà che l fova 6.500 che à prutestà.
eng_text: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text: L ie unì prutestà nce a Paris, a Sofia tla Bulgaria, a Vilnius tla Lituania, a Valetta sun Malta, a Tallinn tl'Estonia y a Edinburgh y a Glasgow tla Scozia.
eng_text: Protests also took place in Paris, Sofia in Bulgaria, Vilnius in Lithuania, Valetta in Malta, Tallinn in Estonia, and Edinburgh and Glasgow in Scotland.

text: A London à prutestà ntëur a 200 persones dan a de plu ufizies di majeri tituleres de dërc d'autëur.
eng_text: In London, about 200 people protested outside some major copyright holders' offices.

text: L mëns passà fovel de majera prutestes tla Polonia canche l stat ova da firmé l'ACTA, cie che à purtà l guviern polach a tò la dezijion de ne ratifiché nia l'acurdanza per l mumënt.
eng_text: Last month, there were major protests in Poland when that country signed ACTA, which has led to the Polish government deciding not to ratify the agreement, for now.

text: La Lituania y la Slabochia à tramedoves sburdlà l pruzedimënt de fé pert dl'ACTA.
eng_text: Latvia and Slovakia have both delayed the process of joining ACTA.

text: La lies Animal Liberation y Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) se damanda inò che l vënie metù ite videocameres ti becheies y tla mazaries dl'Australia.
eng_text: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: L prim ispetëur de RSPCA New South Wales David O'Shannessy ti à dit a ABC che l cuntrol y la ispezions dassëssa vester uperazions normales ti becheies y tla mazaries tl'Australia.
eng_text: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text: "L cuntrol tres videocameres ti manda dessegur n sëni mpurtant a chëla persones che lëura cun i tieres nsci che si bënsté à da vester al prim post."
eng_text: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: La cherta nternaziunela di tramoc dla United States Geological Survey ne mustrova degun tremot tl'Islanda l'ena passeda.
eng_text: The United States Geological Survey international earthquake map showed no earthquakes in Iceland in the week prior.

text: L Ufize meteorologich dl'Islanda ne à nianca no fat al savëi ativiteies de tramoc tl raion de Hekla ntan la 48 ëura permò passedes.
eng_text: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: La majera atività de tramoc à purtà a na fasa de mudamënc y la ie unida a se l dé ai 10 de merz sun la piza dl crater nord urientela dl vulcan.
eng_text: The significant earthquake activity resulting in the phase change had took place on March 10 on the northeast side of the volcano's summit caldera.

text: Nibles fosces nia liedes a ativiteies de n vulcan vën mustredes su japé dl crëp.
eng_text: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text: La nibles ne à nia lascià pro de dì sce al mumënt iel unì a se l dé na eruzion.
eng_text: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text: L Luno ova 120-160 cubich meter de ciarburant cun sé canche l se à spacà y vënc stersc y de gran ondes l à sburdlà de vieres dla prutezions dala ondes dl mer.
eng_text: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text: I joleri à salvà i 12 cumëmbri dl ecuipajamënt y la sëula ferida fova n nés rot.
eng_text: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text: L bastimënt che fova 100 meter lonch, fova sun l viac per jì a tò coche for na cëria de chetum y tl prim ova l'autoriteies tëma che dut degurëssa ora.
eng_text: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text: La pruposta de mudamënt ie bele passeda te tramedoi pertes dl parlamënt tl ann 2011.
eng_text: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text: N mudamënt iel unì fat ntan chësta legislazion canche la segonda frasa ie unida straicheda dala Majon di deputac y ie pona passeda n lunesc te na forma belau medema tl senat.
eng_text: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text: L melsuzes dla segonda frasa che fej la pruposta de pruibì union zeviles danter persones dl medem sés, pudëssa tl daunì plu dessegur ti giaurì la porta a unions zeviles.
eng_text: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text: Aldò dl pruzes unirà la ressoluzion HJR-3 ejamineda da nuef dal legisladëur lità da nuef o l ann 2025 o l ann 206 per resté tl pruzedimënt.
eng_text: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text: I suzesc de Vautier ora dl fé films tol ite nce n scioper dla fam l ann 1973 per cumbater contra cie che ël udova coche zensura politica.
eng_text: Vautier's achievements outside of directing include a hunger strike in 1973 against what he viewed as political censorship.

text: La lege franzeja se à mudà. Si atività va zeruch a canche l ova 15 ani y l ie jit a fé pert dla resistënza franzeja ntan la segonda viera dl mond.
eng_text: French law was changed. His activism went back to age 15 when he joined the French Resistance during World War II.

text: L à cuntà de sé te n liber l ann 1998.
eng_text: He documented himself in a 1998 book.

text: Ti ani 1960 iel jit zeruch tl'Algeria che ova permò arjont la ndependënza per nsenië co fé la rejia de n film.
eng_text: In the 1960s he headed back to newly-independent Algeria to teach film directing.

text: L atlet de iudo dl Iapan Hitoshi Saito che ova venciù doi bedaies d'or pra i Juesc olimpics ie mort tl'età de 54 ani.
eng_text: Japanese judoka Hitoshi Saito, winner of two Olympic gold medals, has died at the age of 54.

text: Coche gauja de si mort iel unì fat al savëi che l ova crëibes ala fiel.
eng_text: The cause of death was announced as intrahepatic bile duct cancer.

text: L ie mort a Osaka n merdi.
eng_text: He died in Osaka on Tuesday.

text: Sciche campion olimpich y dl mond de n iede fova Saito tl mumënt de si mort nce a cë de duc i cumiteies de training dla Federazion dl Iapan.
eng_text: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text: Almancul 100 persones fova pra la festa per festejé l prim aniverser de n pèr che se ova maridà dan n ann.
eng_text: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text: Na festa d'aniverser plu formela ie unida prugrameda plu tert, à dit i funziuneres.
eng_text: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text: L pèr se à maridà tl Texas dan n ann y ie jit a Buffalo per festejé cun cumpanies y parënc.
eng_text: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text: L uem che ova 30 ani y fova nasciù a Buffalo, fova un di cater mazei ntan la stlupeteda, ma si fëna ne se à nia fat mel.
eng_text: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text: Karno ie n nseniant de nglëisc cunesciù, ma nce cuntrastà che à nsenià ti istituc de Modern Education y King's Glory y che à dit de avëi abù 9000 studënc tl mumënt plu aut de si cariera.
eng_text: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text: Te si anutazions tulovel ca paroles che n valgun genitores ratova urdeneres y te tlas univel dit che l blestemova.
eng_text: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text: L ie unì acusà da Modern Education de avëi metù de gran retlams sun la curieres zënza autorisazion y de dì baujies canche l dij che l fova l nseniant de nglëisc a cë de duc.
eng_text: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text: L ie nce bele unì acusà de viulazion di dërc d'autëur, ma zënza unì dat sëura.
eng_text: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text: N studënt de ntlëuta à dit che l rujenova dialet te tlas, mustrova te cumentares co se fé inant per avëi apuntamënc y che l fova propi sciche n cumpani di studënc.
eng_text: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text: Ntan i ultim 3 dejeneies à la Cina svilupà n'economia de marcià, nce sce la resta ufizialmënter n stat comunist.
eng_text: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text: La prima reformes economiches ie unides fates canche Deng Xiaoping fova a cë dla Cina.
eng_text: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text: Da iló inant ie l pëis economich chersciù de 90 iedesc.
eng_text: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: L ann passà à la Cina espurtà per l prim iede de plu auti che l Deutschland y la ti ie jita dant ai Stac Unii coche majer marcià per chësc ciamp.
eng_text: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: L PIL dla Cina pudëssa vester majer che chël di Stac Unii ti doi dejeneies che vën.
eng_text: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: L temporal tropichel Danielle che ie stat l cuarto orcan a chël che n ti à dat n inuem ntan la sajon di orcans tl 2010, se à furmà tl Ozean atlantich urientel.
eng_text: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: La tampesta che fova plu o manco 3000 mailes dalonc da Miami, tla Florida, ova vënc che muserova al mascim 40 mph (64 km/h).
eng_text: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: I scienziac dl National Hurricane Center dij danora che Danielle deventerà sterch sciche n orcan nchin a n mierculdi.
eng_text: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Davia che l orcan ie mo dalonc dala tiera fërma, iel mo for rie da dì ce cunseguënzes che l sarà per i Stac Unii y i Caraibi.
eng_text: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Bobek che ie nasciù tla capitela dla Croazia Zagreb ie deventà tosc cunesciù ntan che l jugova pra l Partizan Belgrado.
eng_text: Born in the Croatian capital, Zagreb, Bobek gained fame while playing for Partizan Belgrade.

text: L ie jit da d'ëi tl 1945 y ie restà nchin l 1958.
eng_text: He joined them in 1945 and stayed until 1958.

text: Ntan che l fova pra chësta scuadra, al fat 403 goi te 468 partides.
eng_text: During his time with the team, he scored 403 goals in 468 appearances.

text: Degun auter ne à mei fat tan de partides o goi per chël club coche Bobek.
eng_text: No one else has ever made more appearances or scored more goals for the club than Bobek.

text: Tl 1995 iel unì cris ora coche miëur jugadëur dla storia dl Partizan.
eng_text: In 1995 he was voted the best player in Partizan's history.

text: I festejamënc à metù man cun n show speziel dla grupa drët cunesciuda sëura dut l mond dl Cirque du Soleil.
eng_text: The celebrations started with a special show by the world-renowned group Cirque du Soleil.

text: Daldò iel unì l'Urchestra sinfonica statela de Istanbul, na band Jannissary, y i cantarins Fatih Erkoç y Müslüm Gürses.
eng_text: It was followed by the Istanbul State Symphony Orchestra, a Janissary band, and the singers Fatih Erkoç and Müslüm Gürses.

text: Daldò iel jit sun paladina i Whirling Dervishes.
eng_text: Then Whirling Dervishes took to the stage.

text: La diva turca Sezen Aksu à ciantà deberieda cun l tenor talian Alessandro Safina y l ciantarin grech Haris Alexiou.
eng_text: Turkish diva Sezen Aksu performed with the Italian tenor Alessandro Safina and Greek singer Haris Alexiou.

text: Ala fin à la grupa de balarins turca Fire of Anatolia purtà dant si show "Troy".
eng_text: To finish, Turkish dance group Fire of Anatolia performed the show "Troy".

text: Peter Lenz, n motozitlist da gara de 13 ani, ie mort do che l à abù n nzidënt sun la Indianapolis Motor Speedway.
eng_text: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Ntan si raida per se sciaudé ite, ie Lenz tumà ju da si motor y si colegh de gara Xavier Zayat ti ie frì ite.
eng_text: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text: Debota iel unì curà dai dutores prejënc ntan la gara y unì menà te n spedel iló daujin ulache l ie pona mort.
eng_text: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Zayat ne se à nia fat mel tl nzidënt.
eng_text: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text: Per cie che à da nfé cun la situazion finanziela globela ie Zapatero jit inant dijan che " l sistem finanziel ie na pert dl'economia, na pert fundamentela."
eng_text: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text: "On abù n ann de crisa finanziela che à abù si mumënt plu acut ti ultim doi mënsc passei y ie rate che śën scumëncia i marcëi finanzieres a se refé."
eng_text: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text: L'ena passeda à Naked News fat al savëi che i uel slargë ora dassënn si ativiteies de nutizieres te rujenedes nternaziuneles pitan trëi trasmiscions nueves.
eng_text: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text: L'urganisazion globela che trasmët bele per nglëisc y per iapanesc ie tl lëur de pité programs tla rujeneda spanuela, taliana y coreana per televijion, te internet y sun i zeluleres.
eng_text: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text: "Per fertuna ne me iel suzedù nia, ma é udù szenes macabres de persones che purvova de spaché i vieresc per pudëi jì ora."
eng_text: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text: La jënt à smacà stuei contra la scipes, ma i vieresc ne se à nia spacà.
eng_text: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text: "Una dla scipes se à ala fin spacà y duc ie unii ora da chël viere" à dit Franciszek Kowal, un de chëi che à sëuravivù.
eng_text: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text: La stëiles dà ju lum y ciaut tres l'energia meneda ora canche i atoms de idrogen se lieia adum (o se dlëiga) per furmé elemënc plu pesoc.
eng_text: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: I scienziac ie tl lëur de mëter adum n reactor che ie bon de perdujer energia ala medema maniera.
eng_text: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Purempò se tratel de na cuestion scialdi cumplicheda da stlarì y l messerà passé truep ani dan ruvé ala realisazion de reatëures a fujion efizienc.
eng_text: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: L’odla de acel se lascia mené dal’ega aldò dla tenscion dla spersa.
eng_text: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: La tenscion dla spersa vën a se l dé ajache la molecules dl'ega sun la spersa dl'ega tira una al'autra plu dassënn de chël che les ne vën nia trates adalerch dala molecules de aria sëura ëiles.
eng_text: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: La molecules dla spersa crieia n fil nia da udëi sun l'ega che ti permët ai ogec, coche l'odla, de sté sëura l'ega via.
eng_text: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: La lama di jadins moderns à doi ëures cun n busc svalà a mez ite. L ëur dopl fej a na maniera che la lama pea ite miec sun la dlacia, nce canche i sta de traviers.
eng_text: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Davia che l fonz dla lama ie n pue’ stort, se storj nce l fil che toca la dlacia, canche la lama se ëuta da una o dal'autra pert.
eng_text: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Chësc ti permët al jadinadëur de fé raides. Sce i jadins se storj a man drëta, uel l jadinadëur raidé a man drëta, sce i jadins se storj a man ciancia, uel l jadinadëur raidé a man ciancia.
eng_text: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: Per jì zeruch al livel de energia da dant, muessi tò y jì l'energia sëuraprò giapeda dala lum.
eng_text: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Chësc feji mandan ora na particula de lum scialdi pitla, tlameda foton.
eng_text: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: A chësc pruzes ti vëniel dit dai scienziac "emiscion stimuleda da nraiazion", ajache i atoms vën stimulei dai raies de lum stersc che gaujea che n foton de lum vënie ora y la lum ie na sort de nraiazion.
eng_text: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: La reprejentazion che vën mostra su coche i atoms fej unì ora fotons. Sambën ie i fotons scialdi mëndri tla realtà che sun la reprejentazion.
eng_text: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: I fotons ie mo plu pitli dla materia de chëla che i atoms ie metui adum!
eng_text: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Do cënt ëura de funziunamënt se bruja ngali i fii dl pëir dla lum y l pëir ne funziunea nia plu.
eng_text: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: L pëir dla lum muessa pona unì baratà ora. L ie de bujën mëter a verda canche n muda l pëir.
eng_text: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Dantaldut iel da druché sun l pom per destudé la lum o da destaché l cabl.
eng_text: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Chësc ajache la lectrisc che va ite tl stecher ulache l ie laite la pert de mitel dl pëir possa gaujé na scasseda sterscia, sce n pea ite tl stecher o tl tòch de mitel dl pëir ntan che l ie mo n pert laite tl stecher.
eng_text: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: L organ plu mpurtant dl sistem dla zirculazion ie l cuer che pumpa l sanch.
eng_text: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: L sanch va dal cuer demez te roles tlamedes arteries y ruva inò zeruch tl cuer tres roles a chëles che n ti dij vëines. Ala roles plu pitles ti dijen capilers.
eng_text: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: I dënz dl triceratop fossa stac boni de spedicé su nia mé la pleces, ma nce la rames y la ravises scialdi dures.
eng_text: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: N valgun scienziac rata che i triceratops se nuriva de palmes cun pleces a forma de felesc, la cycadales, na sort de planta che fova cunesciuda dantaldut tl Tëmp dla Crëida.
eng_text: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Chësta plantes cëla ora sciche na pitla palma cun na curona de pleces spizes y da ficeri.
eng_text: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: N triceratop ëssa pudù se nuzé de si gran bech dur per tré ora la pleces dan maië la taia.
eng_text: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: D'autri scienziac ie dla minonga che chësta plantes ie scialdi da tuesse y che l ne ie nia crëier che vel' dinosaur les maiova, nce sce l pegron y d'autri tieres coche l papagai (che vën dai dinosaures) ie bon de maië pleces o fruc da tuesse.
eng_text: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Ce fazion ëssa pa sun mé la forza de gravità dla luna Io? Sce te fosses sun la spersa de Io, pona pesësses de manco che sun la spersa dla Tiera.
eng_text: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Na persona che pëisa 200 libres (90 kg) sun la tiera pesëssa ntëur a 36 libres (16 kg) sun Io. Chësc uel dì che la fazion dla forza de gravità ie sambën manco sterscia sun la persona.
eng_text: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: L surëdl ne à nia na grosta coche la Tiera ulache n possa sté dessëura. Dut l surëdl ie fat de gas, fuech y plasma.
eng_text: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: L gas vën do y do plu fin sce n va plu dalonc dal zënter dl Surëdl.
eng_text: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: La pert dedoravia che udon canche ti cialon al Surëdl à inuem fotosfera che uel dì ”codla de fuech”.
eng_text: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Ntëur a trëimile ani daldò, tl ann 1610, ti ova l astronom talian Galileo Galilei cialà cun n telescop ala Venus y ova udù che la à fases, avisa coche la luna les à.
eng_text: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: La fases vën a se l dé, ajache mé la pert dla Venus (o dla Luna) che se ëuta contra l Surëdl ie ilumineda. La fases dla Venus sustën la teoria de Copernicus che i planëc raida ntëur al Surëdl.
eng_text: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Pona, puec ani do, tl 1639, ova n astronom nglëisc che ova inuem Jeremiah Horrock, usservà canche la Venus ie passeda.
eng_text: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: La Nghiltiera ova abù n tëmp lonch de pesc do avëi cuncuistà da nuef l Danelaw.
eng_text: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Te uni cajo, tl ann 991 fova Ethelred dan na armeda de vichincs che fova majera de uni autra do chëles de Guthrum n secul dant.
eng_text: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Chësta armeda univa meneda da Olaf Trygvasson, n norvegesc cun ambizions de cuncuisté zeruch si raions che fova sota la duminazion daneja.
eng_text: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Do i contracolps militeres al scumenciamënt fova Ethelred stat bon de se mëter a una cun Olaf, che fova inò jit tla Norvegia per purvé a giapé zeruch si rëni cun suzes mesan.
eng_text: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: L Hangeul ie l sëul alfabet nventà aposta che univa adurvà dala jënt tla vita da uni di. L alfabet fova unì nventà tl 1444 ntan l rëni dl rë Sejong (1418 - 1450).
eng_text: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: L rë Sejong fova l cuarto rë dla dinastia Joseon y l fova un di plu sciazei.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Tl prim ti ovel dat l inuem Hunmin Jeungeum al alfabet Hangeul, che ulova dì ”i drë sonns per l'istruzion dla jënt”.
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: L ie truepa teories sun coche l ie nasciù l sanscrit. Una de chëstes ie de na migrazion ariana da uzidënt de vieres dl'India, ulache i se à tëut pea si rujeneda.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: L sanscrit ie na vedla rujeneda y la possa unì cunfrunteda cun l latin rujenà tl'Europa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: L prim liber cunesciù sun l mond fova unì scrit per sancrit. Do che l fova unì scrit adum la Upanishades, fova l sancrit jit zeruch per rejons de gerarchia.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: L sanscrit ie na rujeneda drët cumplicheda y rica, che vën rateda la funtana per truepa d'autra rujenedes indianes modernes, avisa coche l latin ie la funtana per la rujenedes europeiches coche l franzëus y l spanuel.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Do che la batalia per la Franzia fova fineda, ova la Germania scumencià a se njenië ca per la nvajion dl'ijula dla Gran Bretania.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Al atach ti ova la Germania dat l inuem de codesc ”Uperazion Lion de mer.” La majera pert dl'ermes pesoces y di refurnimënc dla forzes armedes britaniches fova jic perdui ntan l'evacuazion de Dunkirk/Dünkirchen, perchël fova l'armeda plutosc dëibla.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ma la Royal Navy fova mo for scialdi plu sterscia che la marina militera tudëscia (“Kriegsmarine”) y ëssa pudù desdrù uni armeda de nvajion che fossa unida meneda tres l Canal nglëisc.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Purempò fovel mé unì metù su scialdi puecia berches dla Royal Navy dlongia la rutes de nvajion puscibles, ajache i admirai se temova che i fossa jic sot te n atach de julieres tudësc.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Scumencion cun na spiegazion di plans dla Talia. La Talia fova dantaldut la "pitla sor" dla Germania y dl Iapan.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: La ova n'armeda plu dëibla y na marina plu dëibla, nce sce la ova permò costruì cater berches nueves puech dan l scumenciamënt dla viera.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: I obietifs prinzipei dla Talia fova i Paejes africans. Per cuncuisté chëi paejes, ëssi adurvà na basa da ulache la trupes ëssa pudù pië via, a na maniera che la trupes ëssa pudù navighé tres l Mer Mediteran y ti sauté ite al'Africa.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Perchël messovi se deslië dala basa y dala berches britaniches tl Egit. A pert chëla azions ne se aspitoven nia d'auter dala berches da viera talianes.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Śën ruvons pra l Iapan. L Iapan fova n Stat de ijules, avisa coche la Gran Bretania.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: I sotmarins ie berches ududes dant per jì sot'ega y per sté iló per n tëmp plu lonch.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: I sotmarins fova unii tëuc ca tla Prima viera dl mond y tla Segonda viera dl mond. Ntlëuta fovi scialdi pëigri y stlupetova mé scialdi puech lonc.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Al scumenciamënt dla viera jivi scialdi sëura l'ega via, ma canche i radar ova scumencià a se svilupé y a unì for plu avisa fova i sotmarins unii sfurzei a jì sot'ega per schivé de unì udui.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: I sotmarins tudësc univa tlamei U-Boote. I tudësc fova scialdi boni a navighé y a fé jì si sotmarines.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Pervia de si suzes cun i sotmarins, minoven che i tudësc ne ëssa nia trueps de chëi do la viera.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Sci! L rë Tutankhamun, vel' iede numinà nce ”Re Tut” o ”L Mut Rë ”, ie un di rëiesc plu cunesciui dl vedl Egit ti tëmps moderns.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: L ie nteressant da udëi che tl'antichità ne univel nia ratà tan mpurtant y l ne univa nianca no repurtà sun la majera pert dla listes plu vedles di rëiesc.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Purempò l ova la scuvierta de si fòssa tl ann 1922 fat cunëscer dloncora. Depierpul che truepa fòsses dl passà fova unides rubedes ora, fova chësta fòssa perdrët unida lasceda n pesc.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: La majera pert di ogec suplii cun Tutankhamun se à mantenì bën y leprò nce milesc de opres d'ert realisedes cun mitei preziëusc y sasc reres.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Cun la nvenzion dla rodes da raies ie i ciares di Assirs deventei plu lesieres, plu asvelc y i fova njeniei ca miec a ti passé dant ai saudeies y a d'autri ciares.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: La sëites de si balesć murtei fova bones de passé tres la armadures di saudeies averseres. Ntëur l ann 1000 dan Gejù Crist, à i Assirs prejentà la prima ciavaliera.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Na ciavaleria ie n'armeda che cumbat a ciaval. La sela ne fova mo nia unida nventeda, perchël cumbatova i ciavalieres di Assirs sentei mé sun l spinel de si ciavei.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Cunescion truep politicri, scienziac y artisć grecs. Magari ie la persona plu cunesciuda de chësta cultura Omer, l poet vierc che à scrit doi miëurlëures dla leteratura greca: i poems Iliad y Odisse.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sofocles y Aristofan ie ncueicundì mo dramaturgs cunesciui y si pec vën ratei danter la majera opres dla leteratura mundiela.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: N auter grech cunesciù ie l matematicher Pitagoras, renumà dantaldut per si teorema cunesciù sun la relazions danter la pertes di trianguli retanguleres.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: L ie de plu sciazedes sun la cumpëida de persones che rejona hindi. L vën sciazà che la ie danter la segonda y la cuarta rujeneda plu rujeneda sun l mond.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: La cumpëida de persones de rujeneda dl'oma muda sce n cumpëida leprò o nia i dialec che ie scialdi daujin.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: La sciazedes va da 340 milions a 500 milions de persones che rejona y ruva nchin a 800 milions de persones che ie bones de capì la rujeneda.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: L hindi y l urdu se semea tl lessich, ma se desferenzieia tla scritura; tla ciaculedes da uni di se capësc la persones che rejona una dla doi rujenedes de regula danter ëiles.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Ntëur al 15ejim secul fova l’Estonia dl nord sota l nflus sterch dla Germania.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: N valgun patri tudësc ulova ti purté Chël Bel Die plu daujin ala jënt dl luech, perchël ai nventà la rujeneda leterela dl'Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: La se stizova sun l alfabet tudësch y un n pustom, l Õ/õ ie unì metù leprò.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Cun l passé dl tëmp ie truepa paroles mprestedes dal tudësch unides assimiledes. Chësc fova al scumenciamënt dl Iluminism.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Do tradizion jiva l erp dl tron diretamënter pra i saudeies do avëi finà la scola.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Ma Charles jiva al Trinity College a Cambridge, ulache l studiova antropologia y archeologia y plu tert storia, arjunjan 2:2 (na nota de segondo livel bas).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles fova l prim cumëmber dla familia di rëiesc dla Gran Bretania che ova arjont n titul universiter.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: La Turchia europeica (la Tracia urientela o Rumelia sun la penijula balcanica) fej ora l 3% dl stat.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: La spersa dla Turchia ie longia plu de 1.600 chilometri (1.000 mailes) y lergia 800 km (500 mailes), cun na forma plu o manco retangulera.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: La spersa dla Turchia, cun laite i lec, fej ora 783.562 chilometri cuadrac (300.948 mailes cuadrates), de chisc ie 755.688 metri cuadrac (291.773 mailes cuadrates) tl'Asia sud-uzidentela y 23.764 chilometri cuadrac (9.174 mailes cuadrates) tl'Europa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: La spersa dla Turchia ie dl lonch la 37ejima dl mond y possa unì cunfrunteda cun la Franzia metropolitana y l Rëni Unì metui adum.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: La Turchia ie ncertleda ite dal mer da trëi pertes: l Mer Egeo a ovest, l Mer Fosch a nord y l Mer Mediteran a sud.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: L Luxemburg à na storia longia ma si ndependënza va de reviers al 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: La pertes atueles dl Belgio tucova pra l Lussemburgh tl passà, ma ie ruvedes pra l Belgio do la Revoluzion belga di ani 1830.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: L Lussemburgh à for cialà de resté n stat neutrel, ma l ie unì ocupà sibe ntan la Prima Gran Viera che ntan la Segonda dal Deutschland.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Tl 1957 ie l Lussemburgh stat n cumëmber fundadëur de chëla urganisazion cunesciuda al didancuei coche Union Europeica.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: L Drukgyal Dzong ie i sedims de na furtëza y de n cunvënt budist tla pert plu auta dl Paro District (tl luech de Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: L vën dit che tl 1649 à Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel fat su na furtificazion per cumemoré la vënta contra la forzes tibetan-mongoles.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Tl 1951 iel stat n meldefuech nsci che mé n valguna dla relichies de Drukgyal Dzong se à mantenì, coche la imaja de Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Do l meldefuech ie la furtëza unida custedida y stravardeda, restan una dla atrazions plu sensaziuneles dl Bhutan.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Ntan l XVIII secul fova l Cambogia schicià ite danter i doi ujins putënc, l Tailand y l Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: I thais ti ie sautei ite al Cambogia plu iedesc tl XVIII secul y tl 1772 ai desdrù Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Ti ultim ani dl XVIII secul ti ie nce i vietnamesc sautei ite al Cambogia.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: L dejedot percënt di venezuelans ie zënza lëur y trueps de ëi y la majera pert de chëi che ie ocupei lëura tl'economia nia formela.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Doi terc di venezuelans che lëura l fej tl ciamp di servijes, prësciapuech n chert lëura tla ndustria y n cuint lëura tl'agricultura.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Na ndustria mpurtanta per i venezuelans ie l petruele, de chël che l ie n stat de espurtazion netto, nce sce mé un percënt lëura tla ndustria dl petruele.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Abenëura ntan la ndependënza dla nazion ti à l'esperienza dl Verzon Botanich de Singapur judà a trasfurmé l'ijula te na zità-verzon tropichela.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Tl 1981 ie Vanda Miss Joaquim, na orchidea ibrida, unida crissa ora coche ciof dla nazion.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Uni ann de utober vëniel ju feter 1,5 milions de maiaierba dai coi nordics sun la planadures dl sud, passan sëura l ruf Mara via, per gauja dla plueies.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Y pona inò de reviers tl nord tres l uzidënt, inò passan sëura l ruf Mara via, do la pluanies de auril.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Pra la region dl Serengeti tochel l Serengeti National Park, la Ngorongoro Conservation Area y la Maswa Game Reserve tla Tanzania y la Maasai Mara National Reserve tl Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Per mparé a crië media interatifs iel de bujën avëi cumpetënzes cunvenzioneles y tradiziuneles, sciche nce avëi giapà pea la massaria ntan cursc interatifs (storyboarding, audio y video editing, storytelling y n.i.)
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: L design interatif se damanda che n revalutea si fundamënta sun la produzion de media y che n mpera a pensé te na maniera nia lineèra.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: L design interatif se damanda che la cumpunëntes de n proiet se lieia una cun l'autra, ma che les à nce n senificat coche unità spartida.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: L svantaje dl zoom ie che la cumplessità dl focus y la cumpëida de elemënc dla lëntes che ie de bujën per arjonjer na varietà de lunghëza dl focus ie scialdi majera che per lëntes cun na destanza dl focus fissa.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Chësc problem vën for mënder ajache i produtëures de lëntes arjonj for de miëur standard tla produzion de lëntes.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Chësc à lascià pro de fé cun l zoom retrac te na cualità che possa unì cunfrunteda cun chëla arjonta cun lëntes cun na destanza dl focus fissa.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: N auter svantaje dl zoom ie che la giaurida mascima (la velozità) dla lëntes ie per l solit mëndra.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Chësc fej a na maniera che l zoom a bonmarcià ie rie da adurvé te cundizions cun puecia lum y zënza flash.
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un di problems che vën dant l plu suvënz canche n uel cunvertì n film te n format DVD ie l overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: La majera pert di programs dla televijions vën fac per ti plajëi al gran publich.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Per chësta rejon vëniel de dut chël che n vëija tla televijion taià l ëur, la pert suinsom y japé y dales pertes.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Chësc vën fat per garantì che l'imaja cuer dut l video. N ti dij overscan a chësc.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Purtruep vëniel nce taià i ëures canche n fej n DVD y sce i sottituli ie tl video massa daujin al ëur japé, ne vëni nia mustrei defin.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: L ciastel tipicamënter medievel à da for incà stimulà la nmaginazion, descedan ora chedri de turnoies, banchëc y ciavalieres arturians.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Nce a sté a mesa i sedims che ie milesc de ani vedli, iel saurì a descedé tla mënt i sonns y i tofs dla batalies urmei passedes, a audì l bater di fieres da ciaval sun l salejà y a tufé la tëma che vën su dala perjons.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ma se stiza pa nosta nmaginazion sun la realtà? Y dantaldut ciuldì univa pa i ciastiei fac su? Co iesi pa unii desseniei y fac su?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Coche l fova tipich per chël tëmp ie l Ciastel Kirby Muxloe plutosc na cësa fortificheda che n drë ciastel.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Si gran vieresc de scipa y si mures fins ne fossa nia stac boni de tenì permez giut a n atach mirà.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Ti ani ntëur al 1480, canche Lord Hastings ova scumencià a l fé su, fovel pesc tl raion y n messova mé se defënder da de pitla cumbricules de malandrins che rudova ncantëur.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Balanzan ora la forzes fova n sistem cun chël che la nazions europeiches purvova a mantenì la sovranità naziunela de duc i Stac d'Europa.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: L cunzet fova chël che duc i stac d'Europa messova cialé de schivé che una na nazion unisse plu putënta y perchël mudova i guvierns naziunei suvënz si liams per mantenì l balanz.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: La Viera de suzescion spanuela ie stata la prima viera che ova coche problem prinzipel chël de balanzé ora la forzes.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Chësc à senià na mudazion mpurtanta davia che la forzes europeiches ne ova nia plu la viertla de vester vieres religëuses. Perchël ie la Viera di trënta ani stata l'ultima viera ududa sciche viera religëusa.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: L tëmpl de Artemis a Efesus fova unì desdrù ai 21 de lugio dl 356 dan Gejù Crist, cun n meldefuech mpià da Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Aldò dla storia fova si mutivazion chëla de unì cunesciù a uni cost. I abitanc de Efesus, ufendui, ova detlarà che i ne se ëssa mei lecurdà de si inuem.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: L storicher grech Strabo ova plu tert scrit su l inuem, coche l cunescion al didancuei. L tëmpl fova unì desdrù ntan la medema nuet che Alexander l grant fova nasciù.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander se ova pità, canche l fova rë, de fé su da nuef l tëmpl, ma si idea fova unida refudeda. Plu tert, canche Alexander fova bele mort, fova l tëmpl unì fat su da nuef tl 323 dan G.C.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Cële che ti man sibe plu lesiera che la va ntan che te bates la notes sciche l toca - cëla nce de ne fé nia de massa muvimënc che ne ie nia de bujën cun ti dëic.
