eng_text: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: A chësta maniera te stanceres l manco che la va. Lecordete che l ne ie nia de bujën de bater dassënn sun la tlopes per auzé l volum, coche pra l tlavir.
eng_text: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Pra i orguni da butons, druca l mantesc plu dassënn o plu aslune per auzé l volum.
eng_text: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: L misticism ie l ulëi arjonjer na cumenanza cun l'identità, o na cuscienza sentida de na realtà vëira, de na devinità, de na aurità spirituela o de n Die.
eng_text: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: L credënt chier n' esperienza direta, na ntuizion o na vijion tla realtà devina / dla devinità o dla deviniteies.
eng_text: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: I discepuli ti va do a na cërta maniera de viver, o a pratiches che dëssa nurì chësta esperienzes.
eng_text: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: L misticism possa unì desferenzià da d'autra formes de crëidum religëus y de adurazion pervia dla mpurtanza che n ti dà al viver te na maniera persunela y direta esperienzes cuscientes uniches dantaldut chëles che ie seniedes da n carater de pesc, che va sot, beat o nchinamei estatich.
eng_text: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: L sikhisim ie na religion dl subcuntinënt indian. L ie nasciù tla region dl Punjab tl 15ejim secul do che na seta se ova destacà dala tradizion induista.
eng_text: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: I sikhs rata che si crëidum sibe na religion nia lieda al induism, scebën che i recunësc si ravises y la tradizions induistes.
eng_text: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: I sikhs ti dij Gurmat a si religion, che per punjabi uel dì "l troi dl guru". L guru ie n aspet fundamentel de duta la religions indianes, ma tl sikhism al giapà tan na gran mpurtanza da deventé l cuer dl crëidum di sikhs.
eng_text: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: La religion ie unida metuda su tl 15ejim secul da Guru Nanak (1469-1539). L ie pona unit do nuef guru.
eng_text: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Ntant fova de juni dl 1956 la mpermetudes de Krushchev unides metudes ala proa canche tla Polonia fovel revoltes de lauranc che prutestova contra la mancianza de roba da maië y i paiamënc taiei, se ova trasfurmà te na prutesta generela contra l comunism.
eng_text: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Nce sce Krushchev ova ala fin mandà ponzeri per fé orden, ovel dat do a vel' pertenduda economica y lascià pro che Wladyslaw Gomulka che fova drët bënulù unissa numinà prim minister.
eng_text: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: La zeviltà dla Valeda dl Indus fova na zeviltà dl Tëmp dl bront tl subcontinënt indian a nord-vest, che tulova ite la majera pert de chël che ie al didancuei l Pachistan y n valguna regions a nord-vest dl'India y a nord-est dl Afghanistan.
eng_text: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: La zeviltà se ova svilupà ti ciavuei dl ruf Indus da chël che la à giapà l inuem.
eng_text: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Nce sce n valgun studiëusc rata che, davia che la zeviltà vivova nce ti ciavuei urmei sëc dl ruf Sarasvati, ëssela perdrët messù unì tlameda zeviltà Indus-Sarasvati, ti dij d'autri ntant sce zeviltà do Harappa, aldò dl prim di sic archeologics giavei ora ti ani 1920.
eng_text: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: La natura militera dl Mper roman à purtà pro al svilup dl prugres tla medejina.
eng_text: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dutores univa cherdei sota l mperadëur Augustus y furmova nchinamei la prima grupa sanitera romana per ntervënc do la batalies.
eng_text: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: I chirurgs cunesciova de plu sedatifs, cun leprò l morfium trat ora dala sumënzes dl pavé y l scopalamin dala sumënzes de ierbes.
eng_text: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: I ie deventei esperc de amputazions per stravardé i pazienc dala cancrena y nce dla nfascedes a prescion y dla pinzëtes per arteries per fermé l sanch.
eng_text: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Ntan de plu seculi à l Mper roman arjont de gran prugresc tl ciamp dla medejina y à purtà pro a gran pert dl savëi de al didancuei.
eng_text: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: L origami de Pureland ie n origami cun la limitazion che n possa nen fé adum mé un al iede, n ne possa nia l fé adum nce da redëus o te na maniera plu cumplicheda, ma mé tla pertes plu scëmples.
eng_text: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: L fova unì svilupà da John Smith ti ani 1970 per ti judé a chëi che ova puecia esperienza a fé adum o ova n handicap .
eng_text: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: I mutons svilupea scialdi abenëura na cuscienza dla raza y di stereotip dla raza y chisc stereotip dla raza nfluenzea l cumpurtamënt.
eng_text: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Per ejëmpl vën i mutons che se identifichea cun na mancianza raziela che aldò de n stereotip se stënta a scola, menei a se fé ert te scola pernanche i ie unic sëura dl stereotip lià a si etnia.
eng_text: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace ie la terza plata internet plu cunesciuda ti USA y à al mumënt 54 milions de profii.
eng_text: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Chisc sic internet vën scialdi cric su, dantaldut dal ciamp dl'istruzion.
eng_text: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: L ie aspec positifs te chisc sic internet, che stluj danter l auter ite la puscibltà de mëter a jì saurì na plata dla tlas che possa tò ite blog, video, fotografies y d'autra funzions.
eng_text: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: N ruva saurì sun chësta plata mé cun una na adres web, che ie saurida da lecurdé y da dé ite nce per chëi studënc che pudëssa se stenté a adurvé la tastadura o a scrì.
eng_text: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: La possa unì personaliseda per vester saurida da liejer y nce avëi plu o manco culëures, coche n uel.
eng_text: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: L desturp da defizit de atenzion ie n sindrom neurologich de chël che i trëi sintoms tlassics che l fej ora ie l'impulsività, la decunzentrazion y l'iperatività o l'energia sëuraprò.
eng_text: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: L ne à nia da nfé cun ne vester nia boni de mparé, ma l ie n dejorden tl mparé; l reverda l 3 a 5 percënt de duc i mutons, plu o manco nen iel 2 milions di mutons americans.
eng_text: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Mutons cun n desturp da defizit de atenzion (DDA) se stënta a se cunzentré sun cosses coche i lëures de scola, ma i ie boni de se cunzentré sun cosses che ti sà beles coche jughé, ti cialé ai dessënies animei che i à l plu gën o scrì frases zënza sënies de interpunzion.
eng_text: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Chisc mutons possa ruvé te de gran deficulteies, ajache i se lascia tré da cumpurtamënc periculëusc, fej fuera y pruvochea l'autoriteies per stimulé si cervel, che ne possa nia unì stimulà cun la manieres normales.
eng_text: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: L DDA cundizionea i raporc cun d'autri mutons dla medema età, ajache i autri mutons ne ie nia boni de capì ciuldì che i se cumporta nscila o percie che i scrij te chëla maniera o percie che l livel de maduranza ie autramënter.
eng_text: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Davia che la maniera de tò su l savëi y de mparé se à mudà, coche l ie unì descrit dessëura, se à nce mudà l andamënt coche l savëi univa tëut su.
eng_text: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: La maniera de ruvé pra la nfurmazions fova autramënter. N ne fajova nia plu prescion sun la memoria ndividuela, ma n ti dajova plu pëis ala capazità de se lecurdé n test.
eng_text: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Bel avisa iel unì a se l dé cun l Renascimënt de gran mudamënc tla maniera de ti jì permez al mparé y ala defujion dl savëi.
eng_text: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: A defrënza de d'autri primac, ne adrova la sort umana nia plu la mans per se muever inant, purté pëisc o se sbinghé da n lën al auter.
eng_text: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: La mans y i piesc dl scimpansé ie granc y lonc unfat, i desmostra coche l'adurvanza dla mans à tenì l pëis dl corp canche i va sun la cnodles.
eng_text: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: La man dla persona ie plu curta che l pe y cun dëic plu ndrëc.
eng_text: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: I osc fossii dla mans che ie vedli doi o trëi milions de ani, mostra su l mudamënt dla man che se à spezialisà da mesun per se muever inant a mesun per pië ite.
eng_text: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Vel' un rata che sperimenté cun truep sëmies tleres gaujei te na maniera artifiziela possa suvënz vester scialdi sfadiëus.
eng_text: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: La gauja prinzipela de chësc fenomen ie che i sëmies tleres auza l tëmp danter la fases REM.
eng_text: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Cun manco fases REM uni nuet vën chësta situazion, ulache n dorm veramënter y l corp recuperea, for manco y manco tan da deventé n problem.
eng_text: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Chësc ie avisa tan sfadiëus sciche sce te descedësses ora uni vint o trënta menuc y cialësses la televijion.
eng_text: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: La cunseguënzes depënd da tan suvënz che ti cervel prova a semië tlermënter uni nuet.
eng_text: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: La cosses ne jiva nia bën per i talians tl nord dl'Africa feter dal scumenciamënt. Nianca n ena do la detlarazion de viera dla Talia, ai 10 de juni dl 1940, ova i britanics dl undescejim regimënt tëut ite la furtëza Capuzzo tla Libia.
eng_text: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Ntan na miscion a est de Bardia, ova i nglëisc pià l njenier sëurastant dla diescejima armeda taliana, l generel Lasticci.
eng_text: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ai 28 de juni ie l marescial Italo Balbo, l guvernadëur generel dla Libia y suzessëur puscibl de Mussolini, unì mazà a d' infal da na stlupeteda de si trupes ntant che l sbarcova a Tobruk.
eng_text: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: L sport modern dla scherma vën praticà sun de plu livei, dai studënc che l mpera tla universiteies ala cumpetizions prufesciuneles y olimpiches.
eng_text: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Chësc sport vën dantaldut praticà tl format de duel, cun un n cuncurënt che se bat contra n auter.
eng_text: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: L golf ie n juech ulache i jugadëures tira la codles tla bujes cun na maza.
eng_text: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Ntan na raida regulera vëniel jugà dejedot bujes, cun i jugadëures che scumëncia de regula dala prima buja dl percurs y che fina ala dejedotejima.
eng_text: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: L vënc l jugadëur che adrova la mëndra cumpëida de colps, o de trates cun la maza, per finé l percurs.
eng_text: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: La partida vën jugheda sun ierba y la ierba ntëur la buja via vën sieda plu curta y tlameda "green".
eng_text: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: La sort de turism che vën dant l plu suvënz ie plu dessegur chëla che la majera pert dla jënt cunlieia cun l'idea de viac: l turism de paussa.
eng_text: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Chësc ie canche la jënt va te n post che ie scialdi autramënter da si vita da uni di per se paussé ora y se la lascé jì bona.
eng_text: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: La spiages, i parcs de devertimënt y i luesc da jì a camping ie i posć plu vijitei dai turisć dl tëmp liede.
eng_text: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Canche l fin dla vijita te na luegia spezifica ie chël de mparé a cunëscer si storia y cultura, pona vën chësta sort de turism tlameda turism culturel.
eng_text: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: I turisć possa vijité de plu posć de nteres de n paesc avisa o tò la dezijion de se cunzentré mé sun un n raion sëul.
eng_text: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Nce i colonisadëures, che ova udù chësta atività, ova nce damandà aiut.
eng_text: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: La trupes che à judà pea pra la posizions che jiva inant fova l prim y l terzo regimënt dl New Hampshire, metui adum da 200 ëi che stajova al cumando di coloniei John Stark y James Reed (tramedoi ie plu tert deventei generei).
eng_text: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: I ëi de Stark se ova metù su dlongia la sief tl pont plu a nord dla posizion di colonisć.
eng_text: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Canche l mer bas ova giaurì n passaje dlongia l ruf Mystic tl nord-est dla penijula, ovi tosc slungià la sief de viers de nord cun n pitl mur de sas che jiva ite tl'ega sun na pitla spiagia.
eng_text: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gridley o Stark ova batù ju n pel a zirca 100 piesc (30 metri) de destanza dala sief y ova cumandà de ne stlupeté nia nchin che i reguleres ne l ova nia passà via.
eng_text: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: L plan american udova dant de fé pië via assauc coordinei da trëi direzions defrëntes.
eng_text: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: L generel John Cadwalder fajëssa pië via na manobra de destrazion contra la garnijon britanica a Bordentown, per fermé uni renforz.
eng_text: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: L generel James Ewing menëssa 700 saudeies dla miliz sëura l ruf via a Trenton Ferry, sëurantulëssa l cuntrol dl puent sun l ruf Assunpink y schivëssa de lascé mucé la trupes nemiches.
eng_text: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: La forza de assaut prinzipela, metuda adum da 2.400 ëi, passëssa sëura l ruf ora a 9 mailes a nord de Trenton, per se spartì pona te doi grupes, una cumandeda da Greene y l'autra da Sullivan, nsci da mené n atach dan la di.
eng_text: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Cun l passé dla garejeda de sauté da n chert de maila a mesa na maila, devënta la velozità scialdi manco mpurtanta y la cundizion n bujën assolut.
eng_text: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Sambën muessa n sautadëur de prima categoria che sauta mesa na maila, un che possa bater i doi menuc, vester bon de sauté scialdi debota, ma la cundizion muessa unì aleneda a uni cost.
eng_text: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Jì a sauté per i ciamps ntan l inviern, cunlià cun eserzizies te palestra per la pert dessëura dl corp, ie la miëura preparazion per la sajon de sauté.
eng_text: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Na bona alimentazion da sëula ne ie nia assé per fé prestazions de livel aut, ma la miurea dassënn l bënsté generel di atlec jëuni.
eng_text: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Mantenì n balanz energetich sann, mëter n droa usanzes de idratazion efizientes y capì i aspec defrënc dla pratiches de ntegrazion alimentera possa ti judé ai atlec a miuré si prestazions y a aumenté l devertimënt a fé sport.
eng_text: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: La garejeda de sauté sëura na destanza mesana ie n sport relativamënter puech cër; purempò iel truepa melntendudes che reverda i puec pec de atrezatura che n adrova per tò pert.
eng_text: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: I prudoc possa unì cumprei aldò di bujëns, ma la majera pert de chisc arà n pitl o belau degun nflus sun la prestazions.
eng_text: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: I atlec possa raté de avëi plu gën un n prudot nce canche l ne dà degun vantaje reél.
eng_text: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: L atom possa unì cunscidrà un di elemënc costrutifs fundamentei de duta la materia.
eng_text: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: L se trata de na entità cun na cumplessità scialdi auta che ie metuda adum, aldò dl model scemplificà de Bohr, da n nucleus al zënter che vën ncertlà da electrons, n puech coche i planëc che raida ntëur al surëdl - cëla la figura 1.1.
eng_text: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: L nucleus ie metù adum da doi particules: i neutrons y i protons.
eng_text: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: I protons à na cëria eletrica positiva, ntant che i neutrons ne à deguna cëria. I electrons à na cëria eletrica negativa.
eng_text: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: Per ejaminé la vitima muesses n iede cuntrolé la luegia per garantì la segurëza.
eng_text: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: L ie debujën de tenì cont dla posizion dla vitima canche n ti ruva permez y de duc i sënies de avertimënt automatics.
eng_text: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Sce te ësses da te fé mel ntant che te proves a judé, pudësses povester piuré la situazion.
eng_text: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: L stude à abinà ora che la deprescion, la tëma y l pensier catastrofich fej da mediatëures danter l mel y l mpedimënt pra pazienc cun mel al spinel.
eng_text: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Mé la fazion dl pensier catastrofich, y nia dla deprescion y dla tëma, dependova da sescions reguleres de PA strutureda uni ena.
eng_text: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Chëi che ova fat pea a n'atività regulera ova debujën de n majer sustëni n cont dla perzezion negativa dl mel, per recunëscer la desfrënzes danter l mel cronich y l melsté che vën dal muvimënt fisich normal.
eng_text: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: La ududa, o la capazità de udëi, depënd dai organs di sënsc dl sistem visif o dai uedli.
eng_text: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: L ie de plu strutures de uedli, ulache la cumplessità muda aldò di bujëns dl organism.
eng_text: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: La strutures defrëntes à capaziteies defrëntes, les ie sensibles a de plu lunghëzes d'onda y à forzes dl uedl defrëntes, les se damanda nce n'autra elaburazion per ti dé n senificat al input y ai numeri defrënc per funziuné drët.
eng_text: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Na populazion ie na grupa de organisms de na cërta sort te n raion geografich spezifich.
eng_text: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Canche duc i individuums de na populazion ie medemi per chël che reverda na carateristica fenotipica particulera, ti vëniel dit monomorfics.
eng_text: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Canche i individuums à de plu variantes de na cërta carateristica, ti vëniel dit polimorfics.
eng_text: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Nce la colonies de furmies legioneres marcia y fej coa te fases defrëntes.
eng_text: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Tla fasa nomada marcia la furmies legioneres de nuet y se fërma per paussé via per l di.
eng_text: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: La colonia scumëncia na fasa nomada canche la spëisa che ie a despusizion devënta for de manco. Ntan chësta fasa fej la colonia coes per l mumënt che vën mudedes ju uni di.
eng_text: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Uniuna de chësta pruzescions nomades o marces dura ntëur ai 17 dis.
eng_text: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Cie ie pa na zela? La parola zela vën dal latin ”cella”, che uel dì ”pitla majon”, y la ie unida nuzeda l prim iede da n microscopist che usservova la strutura dl corch.
eng_text: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: La zela ie la unità de basa de duta la criatures y duc i organisms ie metui adum da una o plu zeles.
eng_text: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: La zeles ie tan fundamenteles y dezisives per l stude dla vita che les vën suvënz definides i "ziedli dla vita".
eng_text: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: L sistem di nierves straverda la funzions dl corp mandan i mpulsc di nierves ora per dut l corp, tenian nsci l flus dl sanch n muvimënt y liede.
eng_text: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Chisc mpulsc di nierves possa unì mandei tan debota ora per dut l corp ti judan nsci a stravardé l corp da pericui putenziei.
eng_text: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: La stries dal vënt vën dant te n raion mënder che chël de d'autri vënc stersc, ma les possa desdrujer dut chël che les anconta sun si streda.
eng_text: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: La stries dal tëmp desravisea i lëns, zera ora la brëies di frabicac y scirma i auti tl aier. L 2% dla stries dal tëmp plu viulëntes dura plu de trëi ëura.
eng_text: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.

text: Chësc temporal ncherscëul à vënc che arjonj i 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).
eng_text: These monster storms have winds up to 480 km/h (133 m/s; 300 mph).

text: La persona costruësc y adrova linses de ngrandimënt bele da milesc de ani incà.
eng_text: Humans have been making and using lenses for magnification for thousands and thousands of years.

text: A uni maniera, i prim drë telescops ie unii realisei tl'Europa ala fin dl 16ejim secul.
eng_text: However, the first true telescopes were made in Europe in the late 16th century.

text: Chisc telescops adurvova na cumbinazion de doi linses per lascé udëi i obiec dalonc plu daujin y majeri.
eng_text: These telescopes used a combination of two lenses to make distant objects appear both nearer and larger.

text: La ngordia y l egoism fajerà for pert de nëus y l ie tla natura dla cunlaurazion che canche la maiuranza à n prufit, pona saral for da nen davanië de plu tl tëmp curt, sce n se cumporta te na maniera egoistica.
eng_text: Greed and selfishness will always be with us and it is the nature of cooperation that when the majority benefit there will always be more to gain in the short term by acting selfishly

text: N spera che la majera pert dla jënt sibe bona de capì che la miëura opzion alalongia ie chëla de lauré deberieda cun d'autri.
eng_text: Hopefully, most people will realise that their long term best option is to work together with others.

text: Trueps semieia dl di canche la persones puderà viagë de viers de n'autra stëila y scuvierjer d'autri monc, n valguni se damanda cie che l ie iló dedora, d'autri miena che i marzians o d'autra formes de vita posse vester sun n'autra planta.
eng_text: Many people dream of the day when humans can travel to another star and explore other worlds, some people wonder what's out there some belive that aliens or other life may live on another plant.

text: Ma sce l ëssa da suzeder, ne suzederal bonamënter nia per n pez. La stëiles ie tan sparpaniedes ora che l ie miliardes de mailes danter la stëiles "ujines".
eng_text: But, if this ever does happen probably won't happen for a very long time. The stars are so spread out that there are trillions of miles between stars that are "neighbors".

text: Vosc pronepoc sarà povester n di sun n mond che ne ie nia la tiera y se damanderà chi che fova si antenac?
eng_text: Maybe one day, your great grandchildren will be standing atop an alien world wondering about their ancient ancestors?

text: I tieres ie metui adum da truepa zeles. Ëi magia cosses y les digerësc dedite. La majera pert di tieres ie boni de se muever.
eng_text: Animals are made of many cells. They eat things and digest them inside. Most animals can move.

text: Mé i tieres à n cervel (nce sce nia duc i tieres ne l à: la meduses ne à per ejëmpl degun cervel).
eng_text: Only animals have brains (though not even all animals do; jellyfish, for example, do not have brains).

text: I tieres ie sun dut l planët. Ëi geva tl grunt, nudea ti ozeans y jola tl ciel.
eng_text: Animals are found all over the earth. They dig in the ground, swim in the oceans, and fly in the sky.

text: Na zela ie la mëndra unità struturela y funzionela de n organism (criatura) che vif.
eng_text: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of a living (things) organism.

text: Zela vën dala parola latina cella, che uel dì pitla majon.
eng_text: Cell comes from the Latin word cella which means small room.

text: Sce ti cëles ala criatures cun l microscop, uderes che les ie metudes adum da de pitli chedri o codles.
eng_text: If you look at living things under a microscope, you will see that they are made of small squares or balls.

text: Robert Hooke, n biologh nglëisc, ova udù de pitli chedri tl corch cun n microscop.
eng_text: Robert Hooke, a biologist from England, saw small squares in cork with a microscope.

text: Les cialova ora sciche majons. Ël ie stat l prim a usservé zeles mortes.
eng_text: They looked like rooms. He was the first person to observe dead cells

text: I elemënc y la cumbinazions possa passé da n stat al auter zënza se mudé.
eng_text: Elements and compounds can move from one state to another and not change.

text: L nitrogen à sciche gas avisa la medema carateristiches sciche l nitrogen licuid. L status licuid ie plu toch, ma la molecules ie avisa la medemes.
eng_text: Nitrogen as a gas still has the same properties as liquid nitrogen. The liquid state is denser but the molecules are still the same.

text: N auter ejëmpl ie l'ega. La cumposizion dl'ega ie doi atoms de idrogen y un de ossigen.
eng_text: Water is another example. The compound water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

text: La strutura dla molecules ie la medema, unfat sce l se trata de n gas, de n licuid o de n solid.
eng_text: It has the same molecular structure whether it is a gas, liquid, or solid.

text: Nce sce si stat fisich possa se mudé, resta l stat chimich unfat.
eng_text: Although its physical state may change, its chemical state remains the same.

text: L tëmp ie zeche che nes ncertlea y nfluenzea uni nosta azion, ma l ie rie da capì.
eng_text: Time is something that is all around us, and affects everything we do, yet is difficult to understand.

text: L tëmp ie unì studià da studiëusc de religion, de filosofia y de scienza per milesc de ani.
eng_text: Time has been studied by religious, philosophical, and scientific scholars for thousands of years.

text: Sention l tëmp coche na secuënza de avenimënc che va dal daunì al passà passan tres l prejënt.
eng_text: We experience time as a series of events passing from the future through the present to the past.

text: L tëmp ie nce la maniera cun chëla che meton a cunfront tan giut che i avenimënc dura (lunghëza).
eng_text: Time is also how we compare the duration (length) of events.

text: Te posses nstës museré l tëmp che passa usservan tan suvënz che n avenimënt vën for inò. Sce zeche vën for inò dant iel n avenimënt zitlich.
eng_text: You can mark the passing of time yourself by observing the repetition of a cyclical event. A cyclical event is something that happens again and again regularly.

text: Al didancuei vën i computer adurvei per manipulé fotos y i video.
eng_text: Computers today are used to manipulate pictures and videos.

text: Sun computer possen fé animazions lauredes ora a livel aut y chësta sort de animazions vën for plu y plu adurveda tla televijion y ti films.
eng_text: Sophisticated animations can be constructed on computers, and this kind of animation is increasingly being used in television and films.

text: La mujiga vën suvënz tëuta su se nuzan de computer svilupei a livel aut per lauré ora y mescedé adum i sonns.
eng_text: Music is often recorded using sophisticated computers to process and mix sounds together.

text: Tl undescejim y tl vintejim secul univel giut alalongia minà che i prim abitanc dla Nueva Zelanda fossa i Maori, n popul che jiva a ciacia de gran uciei, a chëi che n ti dijova moas.
eng_text: For a long time during the nineteenth and twentieth centuries, it was believed the first inhabitants of New Zealand were the Maori people, who hunted giant birds called moas.

text: La teoria à pona purtà al'idea che l popul di Maori ie emigrà dala Polinesia cun na gran cumpëida de bastimënc y ti à tëut ju la Nueva Zelanda ai Moriori, metan su na sozietà da paur.
eng_text: The theory then established the idea that the Maori people migrated from Polynesia in a Great Fleet and took New Zealand from the Moriori, establishing an agricultural society.

text: Purempò porta proves nueves pro a pensé che i Moriori fova na grupa de Maori dla tierafërma che dala Nueva Zelanda fova emigrei sun la ijules Chatham, svilupan na si cultura dla pesc particulera.
eng_text: However, new evidence suggests that the Moriori were a group of mainland Maori who migrated from New Zealand to the Chatham Islands, developing their own distinctive, peaceful culture.

text: L fova nce n'autra tribù sun la ijules de Chatram. L fova i Maori che fova emigrei dala Nueva Zelanda.
eng_text: There was also another tribe on the Chatham islands these were Maori who migrated away from New Zealand.

text: Ëi se ova tlamà nstësc i Moriori y do n valguna batalies iesi ala fin duc unii mazei ju.
eng_text: They called themselves the Moriori there were a few skirmishes and in the end, the Moriori were wiped out

text: La persones che se ova dat ju per dejeneies alalongia nes à judà a prijé nosta forzes y pascions, valutan nce cun redlëza la deficulteies y nchinamei i falimënc.
eng_text: Individuals who had been involved for several decades helped us appreciate our strengths and passions while candidly assessing difficulties and even failures.

text: Ntan che la persones purtova dant si stories persuneles, de familia y dl'urganisazion, ons giapà nfurmazions de valor sun l passà y sun n valguna persunaliteies che à nfluenzà, tl bon o tl stlet, la cultura dl'urganisazion.
eng_text: While listening to individuals share their individual, family, and organizational stories, we gained valuable insight into the past and some of the personalities who influenced for good or ill the culture of the organization.

text: Nce sce la cunescënza dla storia persunela ne cumporta nia la cumprenscion dla cultura, ti judel ala persones mpo a capì ce pert che les à abù tla storia dl'urganisazion.
eng_text: While understanding one’s history does not assume understanding of culture, it does at least help people gain a sense of where they fall within the history of the organization.

text: Ntan che n valutea i suzesc y n dà pro i fai, vëija la persones singules y i partezipanc duc adum i valores plu soc, i traverc y la forzes che tira inant l'urganisazion.
eng_text: While assessing the successes and becoming aware of failures, individuals and the whole of the participating persons discover more deeply the values, mission, and driving forces of the organization.

text: Te chësc cajo, cherdé a mënt caji de cumpurtamënc da mprenditëur da dant y i suzesc abui ti à judà ala jënt a se giaurì a d'autra mudazions y a na direzion nueva per la dlieja dl post.
eng_text: In this instance, recalling previous instances of entrepreneurial behavior and resulting successes helped people to be open to new changes and new direction for the local church.

text: Chësta stories de suzes à smendrà la tëmes da n mudamënt, crian tl medemo mumënt manieres de pensé positives de viers de n mudamënt tl daunì.
eng_text: Such success stories lessened the fears of change, while creating positive inclinations toward change in the future.

text: La manieres de pensé che va a una ie tecniches de ressoluzion di problems che mët adum ideies o ciamps defrënc per abiné na soluzion.
eng_text: Convergent thinking patterns are problem solving techniques that unite different ideas or fields to find a solution.

text: L pont zentrel de chësta maniera de pensé ie l slune, la logica y la prezijion, ma nce recunëscer i fac tres tecniches che ie bele y abinan adum nfurmazions.
eng_text: The focus of this mindset is speed, logic and accuracy, also identification of facts, reapplying existing techniques, gathering information.

text: L fator plu mpurtant de chësta maniera de pensé ie: l ie mé una na resposta drëta. Te pënses mé a doi respostes, drëta o fauza.
eng_text: The most important factor of this mindset is: there is only one correct answer. You only think of two answers, namely right or wrong.

text: Chësta maniera de pensé ti va do a n valguna pruzedures scientifiches o de usanza.
eng_text: This type of thinking is associated with certain science or standard procedures.

text: La persones cun chësta maniera de pensé à n pensier logich, les sà da memorisé schemes, da ti abiné soluzions ai problems y da ti vester a proves scientifiches.
eng_text: People with this type of thinking have logical thinking, are able to memorize patterns, solve problems and work on scientific tests.

text: La persona ie dessegur la sort cun l majer talënt de liejer i pensieres di autri.
eng_text: Humans are by far the most talented species in reading the minds of others.

text: Chël uel dì che son boni de udëi danora cun suzes cie che d'autra jënt sënt, pënsa, miena, sà o uel.
eng_text: That means we are able to successfully predict what other humans perceive, intend, believe, know or desire.

text: Danter chësta capaziteies ie chëla de capì la ntenzions di autri fundamentela. La nes dà l mesun de stlarì situazions dl cumpurtamënt dl corp che à eventualmënter n senificat dopl.
eng_text: Among these abilities, understanding the intention of others is crucial. It allows us to resolve possible ambiguities of physical actions.

text: Per ejëmpl, sce te vëijes zachei che romp ite l viere de n auto, pudësses bonamënter miné che l uel ti rubé l auto a n fulestier.
eng_text: For example, if you were to see someone breaking a car window, you would probably assume he was trying to steal a stranger’s car.

text: L messëssa unì nterpretà autramënter sce ël ëssa perdù la tleves dl auto y sce ël ëssa nstës purvà a rumpì ite si auto.
eng_text: He would need to be judged differently if he had lost his car keys and it was his own car that he was trying to break into.

text: L NMR se stiza sun n fenomen dla fisica cun l inuem resonanza manietica nutleèra (RMN), che fova unì abinà ora ti ani 1930 da Felix Bloch (che laurova tl'Università de Stanford) y da Edward Purcell (dl'Università de Harvard).
eng_text: MRI is based on a physics phenomenon called nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR), which was discovered in the 1930s by Felix Bloch (working at Stanford University) and Edward Purcell (from Harvard University).

text: Chësta resonanza fej a na maniera che l ciamp manietich y la ondes radio porta pro che i atoms manda ora sënies dl radio dëibli.
eng_text: In this resonance, magnetic field and radio waves cause atoms to give off tiny radio signals.

text: Tl 1970 à l dutor y tuadëur Raymond Damadian scuviert la fundamënta dl'adurvanza dla resonanza manietica tres la grafica sun computer coche strumënt de dianiosa di dutores.
eng_text: In the year 1970, Raymond Damadian, a medical doctor and research scientist, discovered the basis for using magnetic resonance imaging as a tool for medical diagnosis.

text: Cater ani do fovel unì cunzedù n brevet, l prim dl mond tl ciamp dla resonanza manietica.
eng_text: Four years later a patent was granted, which was the world's first patent issued in the field of MRI.

text: Tl 1977 à l dutor Damadian purtà a piz la costruzion dl prim scanner per la resonanza manietica per dut l corp, a chël che l ti à dat l inuem "Indomitable" (ce ne se lascia nia custemé).
eng_text: In 1977, Dr. Damadian completed the construction of the first “whole-body” MRI scanner, which he called the ”Indomitable”.

text: La comunicazion nia sincronica dà tëmp per pensé do y per ti respuender ai autri.
eng_text: Asynchronous communication encourages time for reflection and reaction to others.

text: L ti permët ai studënc de lauré aldò de si ritm y de cuntrolé l slune dla nfurmazions didatiches.
eng_text: It allows students the ability to work at their own pace and control the pace of instructional information.

text: Sëuraprò ie la limitazions dl tëmp mëndres, cun la puscibltà de orars de lëur flessibli. (Bremer, 1998)
eng_text: In addition, there are fewer time restrictions with the possibility of flexible working hours. (Bremer, 1998)

text: L'adurvanza dl internet y dl World Wide Web ti dà ai studënc l mesun de avëi azes ala nfurmazions te uni mumënt.
eng_text: The use of the Internet and the World Wide Web allows learners to have access to information at all times.

text: I studënc possa nce ti fé dumandes ai duzënc te uni mumënt ntan l di y giapa de regula respostes scialdi aslune, mpede messëi aspité sun l'ancunteda persunela ududa dant.
eng_text: Students can also submit questions to instructors at any time of day and expect reasonably quick responses, rather than waiting until the next face-to-face meeting.

text: La maniera de mparé postmoderna ie liedia da prinzips assoluc. L ne ie nia mé una na maniera de mparé che vel.
eng_text: The postmodern approach to learning offers the freedom from absolutes. There is no one good way to learn.

text: L ne ie nia mé una na drëta cossa da mparé. L mparé vën a se l dé tres l'esperienza danter l studënt y la cunescënza purteda dant.
eng_text: In fact, there is not one good thing to learn.Learning takes place in the experience between the learner and the knowledge presented.

text: Nosta esperienza atuela cun duta la teleshow pastelnedes adum nstësc a cësa che porta dant nfurmazions y che se stiza sun l prinzip dl mparé mostra sun chësc pont.
eng_text: Our current experience with all the do-it-yourself and information presenting, learning-based television shows illustrates this point.

text: Trueps de nëus ie usei a ti cialé a na teleshow che nes nfurmea de n pruzes o de n'esperienza pra chëla che nëus ne fajeron mei pea o ne adurveron mei chëla cunescënza.
eng_text: So many of us find ourselves watching a television show that informs us of a process or experience in which we will never participate or apply that knowledge.

text: Ne fajeron mei la revijion de n auto, ne fajeron mei na funtana te nosc verzon, ne fajeron mei n viac tl Peru per analisé i vedli sedims, o ne cumederon mei su la cësa de nosc ujin.
eng_text: We will never overhaul a car, build a fountain in our backyard, travel to Peru to examine ancient ruins, or remodel our neighbour's house.

text: De gra ala rë di cabli sota l'ega de fibra de viers dl'Europa y l satelit a vëta lergia à la Groenlandia n bon cunliamënt y l 93% dla populazion à azes a internet.
eng_text: Thanks to undersea fiber optic cable links to Europe and broadband satellite, Greenland is well connected with 93% of the population having internet access.

text: Vosc hotel o albierch (sce stajëis sëura nuet te na cësa per gesć o te majons privates) à bonamënter l Wi-Fi o n computer cunlià cun internet y uni luech à n internet café o n post ulache l ie l Wi-Fi publich.
eng_text: Your hotel or hosts (if staying in a guesthouse or private home) will likely have wifi or an internet connected PC, and all settlements have an internet cafe or some location with public wifi.

text: Coche bele dit dessëura, scebën che la parola eschimesc vën mo azeteda ti Stac Unii, ne vëniela nia tëuta su bën dala populazions artiches ora di Stac Unii, dantaldut tl Canada.
eng_text: As mentioned above, though the word "Eskimo" remains acceptable in the United States, it is considered pejorative by many non-U.S. Arctic peoples, especially in Canada.

text: Nce sce chësta parola possen audì che la vën adurveda dala jënt dl post tla Grönlandia, messëssa chëi da oradecà schivé de la adurvé.
eng_text: While you may hear the word used by Greenlandic Natives, its use should be avoided by foreigners.

text: La jënt dl post dla Grönlandia se à dat l inuem Inuit tl Canada y Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), un dla Grönlandia, tla Grönlandia.
eng_text: The native inhabitants of Greenland call themselves Inuit in Canada and Kalaalleq (plural Kalaallit), a Greenlander, in Greenland.

text: La criminalità y l'averscion contra i fulestieres n generel ne ie feter nia cunesciudes tla Grönlandia. Nce tla ziteies ne iel degun raions periculëusc.
eng_text: Crime, and ill-will toward foreigners in general, is virtually unknown in Greenland. Even in the towns, there are no "rough areas."

text: L frëit ie povester l sëul pericul a chël che la jënt nia njenieda muessa ti jì permez.
eng_text: Cold weather is perhaps the only real danger the unprepared will face.

text: Sce jëis a ti cialé ala Grönlandia ntan la sajons frëides (tenian cont che plu che n va de viers dl nord, plu frëit che l devënta), iel fundamentel se tò pea guant bëndebò ciaut.
eng_text: If you visit Greenland during cold seasons (considering that the further north you go, the colder it will be), it is essential to bring warm enough clothing.

text: I dis scialdi lonc ntan l instà possa purté a problems de ne durmì nia giut assé y perchël nce a problems de sanità.
eng_text: The very long days in the summer can lead to problems getting sufficient sleep and associated health issues.

text: Ntan l instà iel nce da mëter a verda sun la zanzares nordiches. Nce sce les ne taca deguna malaties, posseles vester ncompres.
eng_text: During the summer, also watch out for the Nordic mosquitoes. Although they do not transmit any diseases, they can be irritating.

text: Scebën che l'economia de San Francisco depënd da si cundizion de vester na atrazion turistica nternaziunela, iela mpo desferenzieda.
eng_text: While San Francisco's economy is linked to it being a world-class tourist attraction, its economy is diversified.

text: I ciamps de lëur plu mpurtanc ie i servijes prufesciunei, l guviern, la finanza, l cumerz y l turism.
eng_text: The largest employment sectors are professional services, government, finance, trade, and tourism.

text: Si reprejentazions de mujiga, de films y de cultura populera purtedes dant suvënz à judà pea a fé cunëscer la zità y si monumënc sëura dut l mond.
eng_text: Its frequent portrayal in music, films, literature and popular culture has helped make the city and its landmarks known throughout the world.

text: A San Francisco se à svilupà na nfrastrutura turistica scialdi granda, cun truep hotiei, truepa ustaries y truepa strutures ezelëntes per cungresc.
eng_text: San Francisco has developed a large tourist infrastructure with numerous hotels, restaurants, and top-notch convention facilities.

text: San Francisco ie nce un di miëur posć dl luech per maië asiatich: corean, thailandesc, indian y iapanesc.
eng_text: San Francisco is also one of the best places in the nation for other Asian cuisine: Korean, Thai, Indian, and Japanese.

text: N viac a Walt Disney World ie n pelegrinasc mpurtant per truepa families americanes.
eng_text: Traveling to Walt Disney World represents a major pilgrimage for many American families.

text: L program tipich dl viac ie de regula julé nchin al aeroport nternaziunel de Orlando, furné cun la curiera de viers de n hotel daujin a Disney, resté plu o manco n'ena dedite tl areal de Disney y jì daldò zeruch a cësa.
eng_text: The "typical" visit involves flying into Orlando International Airport, busing to an on-site Disney hotel, spending about a week without leaving Disney property, and returning home.

text: L ie truepa pusciblteies a despusizion, ma chësc ie cie che pënsa la majera pert dla jënt canche la rejona de "jì a Disney World".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Truepa chertes vendudes online sun plates web sciche eBay o Craigslist ie chertes per plu dis che vel per de plu parcs, ma les vën adurvedes mé n pert.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Nce sce l ie na pratica scialdi normala, vëniela pruibida dala Disney: la chertes ne possen nia dé inant.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Per ciampejé sun l ëur dl Grand Canyon iel de bujën de na autorisazion backcountry.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: L'autorisazions ie limitedes per stravardé l canyon y vën dates ora l prim di dl mëns, cater mënsc dan che l mëns scumëncia.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Nscila vëniel metù a despusizion na autorisazion backcountry per uni di de mei, ai prim de jené.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: I posć plu cunesciui, coche l Bright Angel Campground dlongia l Phantom Ranch, vën n generel bele mplenii cun la dumandes dates ju l prim di de giaurida dla apustedes.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Per la lizënzes resservedes a chëi che va a pe iel udù dant n numer limità de autorisazions, metudes a despusizion a chëi che ruva dant.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Jì tl Sudafrica cun l auto ie na maniera straurdinera per amiré duta la belëza dla cuntreda, ma nce n mesun per arjonjer posć che ne ie zënza nia pra la raides turistiches normales.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: L possa unì fat cun n auto normal sce l vën prugramà avisa, ma n auto che tira sun 4 rodes vën scialdi cunsià y truep posć ie da arjonjer mé cun n auto trat cun cater rodes de livel plu aut.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Canche ve njenieis ca al viac tenide cont che l'Africa dl sud ie bën n stat segur, ma che nia duc i paejes ujins l ie.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: I recuisic y i custimënc di visum muda aldò di stac y depënd dal luech da ulache n vën.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Uni post à nce leges spezifiches che scrij dant ciun njins de emergënza che n muessa avëi te auto.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls ie na zità tla pert uzidentela de Zimbabwe, sun l cunfin cun Livingstone, tla Zambia y dlongia Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: La zità ie daujin ai pisciadoies, che ie la atrazion prinzipela, ma chësta destinazion turistica cunesciuda ti pieta sibe a tramedoi, a chëi che chier aventures y a chëi che uel ti cialé truepa pusciblteies de sté per de plu dis.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ntan la sajon dla plueia (da nuvëmber nchin merz) deventerà l volum d'ega majer y i pisciadoies sarà plu sensaziunei.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Te vënies dessegur mol sce te passes sëura l puent o sce te ves a pe sun i troies dlongia i pisciadoies.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Dal'autra pert, iel propi ajache l volum d'ega ie tan aut che ne possen nia udëi i pisciadoies, che ie ascundui per gauja de duta chësta ega!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Fòssa de Tutankhamon (KV62). KV62 ie plu dessegur la fòssa plu cunesciuda tla valeda, l post dla scuvierta de Howard Carter tl 1922 dla supeltura belau mo ntiera dl rë jëun.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: N cunfront al'autra fosses di rëiesc, ne merita la fòssa de Tutankhamon belau nianca no de unì vijiteda, per tan plu pitla y manco decureda che la ie.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Chëi che uel udëi coche la mumia ie unida danejeda ntan che n ova purvà a la tò ora de vascel, resterà descunselei, ajache l ie mé l cë y la sciables da udëi.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: La richëzes dla fòssa da stramp beles ne ie nia plu laite, ma les ie unides purtedes tl Museum dl Egit a Cairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: I turisć che à puech tëmp a despusizion fajëssa miec a passé l tëmp nzaul d'auter.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km a sud-vest de Siem Reap. Chësc tëmpl suinsom dl col ie unì fat su ala fin dl nono secul, ntan l rëni dl rë Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: L se mpaia a jì sun l col per l'atmosfera scura dl tëmpl y la bela ududa sun l lech Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Jì a ti cialé al post se lascia saurì cunlië cun na jita cun la berca sun l lech.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Per jì ite tl tëmpl iel de bujën passé sëura Angkor Pass via, perchël ne te desmincë nia de tò pea ti passaport canche te ves de viers dl Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Gerusalem ie la capitela y la majera zità de Israel, nce sce la majera pert di autri stac y la Nazions Unides ne la recunësc nia coche la capitela de Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: La vedla zità sun i coi dla Giudea à na storia faszinënta che tol ite milesc de ani.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: La zità ie sacra per la trëi religions monoteistes, ebraism, cristianejim y islam y ie da raté n zënter spirituel, religëus y culturel.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Per gauja dl senificat religëus dla zità y dantaldut per i truep sic tla Zità Vedla, ie Gerusalem una dla destinazions turistiches prinzipeles te Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Gerusalem à truep sic de nteres storich, archeologich y culturel, ma nce zëntri cumerziei, bar y ustaries plëns de vita y de jënt.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: L Ecuador se damanda che i zitadins cubans giape na lëtra de nvit danora dan jì ite tl Ecuador tres i aeroporc nternaziunei o tres i posć de azes sun l cunfin.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Chësta lëtra muessa unì legaliseda dal Minister per i afares cun i stac fulestieres dl Ecuador y se tenì a n valgun recuisic spezifics.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Chisc recuisic ie unic dac dant per garantì n flus de migrazion urganisà danter i doi Stac.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: I zitadins cubans che à na cherta vërda di Stac Unii muessa jì da n consulat dl Ecuador per ti damandé de unì delibrei da chësc recuisit.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: L passaport muessa valëi mo per almanco 6 mënsc do che n ie piei via per l viac. Sciche prova de tan giut che n ie de viac iel de bujën de na cherta dl viac de jì y de unì de reviers.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: La raides ie plu economiches sce n fej pert de na majera grupa, perchël sce te ies da sëul o cun un n cumpani, prova a ancunté d'autra persones per fé na grupa de cater o sies persones y giapé nsci n miëur priesc per persona.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Ma de chësc ne muesses nia te cruzië, ajache i turisć vën suvënz mescedei per fé plëns i auti.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: L semea plutosc che l sibe na maniera per trapulé la jënt y ti fé crëier de messëi paië de plu.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Chësc crëp ërt che pica ora dal pont plu a nord dl Machu Picchu ie suvënz l dovia de truepa fotos di sedims.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: A ti cialé da japé al n cialé ora n pue' da temëi y jì su ie ërt y da stancë, ma la persones te bëndebò de bona cundizions fisiches ie bones de ti vester te zirca 45 menuc.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Dlongia na gran pert dl troi iel scialieres de sasc y ti tòc plu ërc pieta la cordes de acel n mesun de sustëni.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Dit chësc, aspitëdeve de resté zënza fla y metëde a verda ti tòc plu ërc, dantaldut sce i ie moi, davia che l possa deventé riesc periculëus.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Dlongia la piza iel na pitla caverna plutosc bassa y scialdi strënta che n muessa passé via.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Per jì a ti cialé ala cuntreda y ala fauna dla Ijules Galapagos vëniel cunsià de fé n viac cun la berca, avisa coche Charles Darwin ova fat tl 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Passa 60 bastimënc passa via y ca per l'eghes dla Ijules Galapagos, de dimenscions che va dai 8 ai 100 passajieres.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: La majera pert dla jënt aposta scialdi giut danora si post (davia che i bastimënc ie suvënz plëns ntan la sajon auta).
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Cialëde che l agënt pra chël che apustëis sebe nëut dla Ijules Galapagos y che l ebe la cunescënzes de de plu sortes de bastimënc.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: A chësta maniera jirà vosc nteresc y/o vosc limic particuleres a una cun l bastimënt plu adatà per vo.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Dan che i spanuei fova unii tl 16ejim secul, fova l Chile dl nord sota l dumëne di Incas, ntan che la persones dl post dl'Araucania (Mapuche) vivova tla pert zentrela y dl sud.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: I Mapuche ie nce stac una dla ultima grupes ndependëntes dl'America che ne ie nia unides trates ite defin dal dumëne spanuel, ma permò do la ndependënza dl Cile.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Nce sce l Cile ova detlarà la ndependënza tl 1810 (danter la vieres de Napolion che ova lascià la Spania zënza n guviern che funziunëssa per n doi ani alalongia), fova la vënta tlera contra i spanuei permò unida arjonta tl 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: La Republica dominicana (per spanuel: República Dominicana) ie n Stat di Caraibi che se slergia ora sun la pert urientela dl'ijula de Hispaniola y l rest toca pra Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Daujin a spiages cun sablon blanch y cuntredes da mont ie chësc post l ncësa dla plu vedla zità europeich dl 'America, al didancuei fejela pert de Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: L'ijula ie unida abiteda tl prim dai Taìnos y dai Caribs. I Caribs fova n popul che rujenova l Arawak y che fova ruvei ntëur al 10.000 dan G.C.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Tl tëmp de puec ani do che l fova unii i espluradëures europeics fova la populazion di Tainos unida desmendrida dassënn dai spanuei che i ova cuncuistà.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Aldò de Fray Bertomé de lâs Casas (Tratado de lâs Indias) ova danter l 1492 y l 1498 i spanuei che ova cuncuistà l raion mazà zirca 100.000 Taínos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardín de la Unión. Chësc post fova l atrium de n cunvënt dl 17ejim secul, de chël che l tëmpl de San Diego ie l sëul frabicat che se à mantenì.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: L ie śën la plaza zentrela y l ie for truepa cosses che vën fates, ntan l di y de nuet.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: L ie n valgun restauranc ntëur al parch y domesdì y da sëira vëniel tenì cunzerc debant sun l palch zentrel.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso ("Alea dl bos"). Doi śoldri spartii mé da 69 zentimetri ie l ncësa de na vedla lijënda d'amor.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Per n valguna munëides ve cunterà n valgun mutons la storia.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: La ijula de Bowen ie n post cunesciù per na jita de n di o per na fin dl'ena che pieta la puscibltà de fé kayak, de jì a crëp, de jì tla butëighes, ti restauranc y de fé mo truepa d'autra cosses sëuraprò.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Chësta cumenanza autentica ie da abiné a Howe Sound daujin a Vancouver y n possa ti ruvé permez saurì cun n taxi sëura l'ega che pëia via da Granville Island tl zënter dla zità de Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Per chëi che à gën ativiteies alalergia ie na jita sun l troi Sea to Sky fundamentela.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Whistler (1,5 ëura de auto dalonc da Vancouver) ie na zità cëra, ma scialdi cunesciuda pervia di Juesc Olimpics da d'inviern dl 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: D'inviern possen se goder n valguna dla plu bela pistes da jì cun i schi dl'America dl nord y d'instà possen purvé ora n valgun drët de biei troies per la rodes da mont.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: L'autorisazions muessa unì apustedes danora. Te adrove na autorisazion per sté sëuranuet a Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena ie la sëula stazion di rangers che pieta n post per sté sëuranuet cun cëives ciauc daujin al ciampejé. La Leona, San Pedrillo y Los Patos pieta mé la puscibltà de fé camping zënza pudëi giapé zeche da maië.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: N possa damandé do l'autorisazions per parchejé diretamënter tla stazion di rangers a Puerto Jiménez, ma i ne azetea nia chertes de credit.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: L servisc de parchejé (MINAE) ne scrij nia ora l'autorisazion de parchejé plu de n mëns dan ruvé adalerch.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol pieta n servisc de apusteda per n custimënt de US30$ , o $10 per l pas de n di; i detail ie sun si plata Corcovado.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: La Ijules Cook ie n raion de ijules liedes te na maniera liedia ala Nueva Zelanda, tla Polinesia, a mesa l Ozean Pazifich dl sud.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: L ie na grupa de ijules cun 15 ijules sparpaniedes ora sun 2,2 milions de km2 tl ozean.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Cun l medem raion dl tëmp sciche Hawaii vën la ijules datrai ratedes sciche sce les tuchëssa pra Hawaii.
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Nce sce la ie mëndra, ti lecordela a n valgun vijitadëures plu vedli coche Hawaii cialova ora dant, zënza duc chëi gran hotiei y l rest dl svilup.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: La ijules Cook ne à deguna ziteies, ma les ie metudes adum da 15 ijules defrëntes. La majeres ie Rarotonga y Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ti paejes svilupei de al didancuei ie la piteda de majons cun gusté nëubles deventeda na forma d'ert.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ala fin se la stritela i B&B sambën ora pra la doi cosses prinzipeles: la besc da liet y l gusté.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: De cunseguënza spera un de abiné tla miëura strutures l liet plu nëubl, povester na chëutra fata a man o n liet coche l fova n iede.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: L gusté possa vester cun prudoc tipics de sajon dla region o spezialiteies dl patron de cësa.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Coche curnisc possen avëi na vedla cësa storica cun n aredamënt antich, n ntëurvia njenià ca drët bel y na nudadoia.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Senté ite te ti auto y pië via per n viac lonch à na atrazion duta sia te si scemplëza.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Autramënter che cun de majeri auti, sares bonamënter bele bon de avisé ti auto y cunesceres si limitazions.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Mëter su na tënda sun na puscion privata o te na zità unfat de ce grandëza possa saurì tré atenzions nia uludes.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: N curt ie l'adurvanza de ti auto n bon mesun per fé n bel viac sun streda, ma dinrer iel per si vester na maniera de "ciampejé".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Ciampejé te auto ie mesun sce te es n gran minivan, n SUV, na berlina o n station wagon cun sic da lascé ju.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: N valgun hotiei ie na arpejon dl'età d'or dla ferates a tanf o di transatlantics, dan la Segonda viera mundiela, tl 19ejim y 20ejim secul.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Chisc hotiei fova tla luegia ulache la jënt rica y cunesciuda pudova sté via per l di y ulache i giapova suvënz nce velch de bon da maië y n pue' de vita ntan la nuet.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: L vedl stil, la mancianza dla ultima sauridanzes y na cërta grazia zënza tëmp fej ënghe pert de si carater.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Scebën che i ie n puscion privata vëni dat d'albierch datrai a capi de Stat o a d'autra persunaliteies n vijita.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: N viagiadëur cun n grum de scioldi pudëssa tò n cunscidrazion de fé na raida ntëur al mond cun l fliegher y se fermé for inò per sté te truep de chisc hotiei.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Na rë de barat de albierc ie na urganisazion che cunlieia viagiadëures cun la jënt dl post che sta tla ziteies che i va a vijité.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Per ruvé ite te na tel rë muessen normalmënter mé scrì ora n formuler online, nce sce n valguna rëies pieta o se damanda nce n cuntrol sëuraprò.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Na lista de cuatieres a despusizion vën pona metuda da garat te na forma stampeda y/o online, datrai cun referënzes y rezenscions de d'autri viagiadëures.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing fova unì metù su de jené dl 2004 do che l programadëur nfurmatich Casey Fenton ova giapà n jol a bonmarcià tl'Islanda, ma ne ova nia plu giapà n post per sté sëura nuet.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.
