text: L ova scrit na e-mail a studënc dla università dl post y ova giapà truepa prupostes per sté d'albierch debant.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: I albierc dla junanza tol su dantaldut jënt jëuna - n seniëur tipich à plu o manco vint ani - ma n abina suvënz nce viagiadëures plu vedli iló.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Families cun mutons vëijen dinrer, ma cër albierc dla junanza lascia pro che stebe te majons privates.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: La zità de Beijing tla Cina sarà la zità di Juesc Olimpics da d'inviern dl 2022 y nsci sarala la prima zità che arà abù sibe i Juesc Olimpics da d'instà che chëi da d'inviern.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: A Beijing saral la zeremonies de giaurida y de stluta y la manifestazions sun dlacia dedite.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: L'autra manifestazions cun i schi sarà tl raion da jì cun i schi de Taizicheng a Zhangjiakou, zirca 220 km (140 mailes) dalonc da Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: La majera pert di tëmpli tën uni ann n festival che scumëncia de nuvëmber y fina a mez mei y che muda aldò dl calënder anuel de uni tëmpl.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: La majera pert di festival vën zelebrei coche pert dl aniverser dl tëmpl o coche cumplì di ani dla majera devinità o de uni auter avenimënt plu mpurtant lià al tëmpl.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: L festival tl tëmpl de Kerala ie scialdi nteressant da udëi, cun pruzescions reguleres de elefanc decurei, cun mujiga dl'urchestra dl tëmpl y d'autri festejamënc.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Na fiera mundiela (a chëla che n ti dij normalmënter World Exposition, o bel scëmpl Expo) ie n gran festival nternaziunel d'ert y dla scienza.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: I stac che fej pea prejënta si opres d'ert y si njins educatifs te pavillon naziunei per mustré argumënc globei o la cultura y la storia de si stat.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: L'espusizions nternaziuneles de verzons ie spezialisedes sun manifestazions che mostra la cumposizions de ciofs, i verzons botanics y dut chël che à da nfé cun la plantes.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Nce sce i pudëssa n teoria unì metui a jì uni ann (sce i ie te de plu stac), ne iela tla pratica nia nscila.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Chisc evënc dura de regula da trëi a sies mënsc y vën tenii te posć che ne ie nia mëndri de 50 hectar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: L ie truep formac de film defrënc che ie unii adurvei ti ani passei. L film standard da 35 mm (negatifs de 36 per 24 mm) ie l plu adurvà.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: De regula possel unì mudà ora saurì canche l fina y pieta na ressoluzion che n possa plu o manco paredlé cun n DSLR da śën.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: N valgun aparac da fé fotos de format mesan adrova n format de 6 per 6 cm, plu avisa n negatif de 56 per 56 mm.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Chësc pieta na ressoluzion che ie feter cater iedesc tan granda coche chëla de n negatif da 35 mm (3136 mm2 contra 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: I tieres salveresc ie danter i motifs plu riei per n fotograf y n adrova na cumbinazion de fertuna, pazienza, esperienza y de bon njins.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: La fotografia di tieres salveresc vën suvënz rateda zeche de normal, ma coche la ie pra la fotografia n generel, vel n retrat tan che mile paroles.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: La fotografia de tieres salveresc se damanda suvënz n teleubietif lonch, nce sce motifs coche na schiera de uciei o na pitla criatura adrova d'autri ubietifs.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Truep tieres esotics ie riei da abiné y i parcs à datrai regules n cont dl fé fotografies per fins cumerziei.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Tieres salveresc possa vester spevesc o agressifs. L ambient ntëur via possa vester frëit, ciaut o vester a n'autra maniera dur.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: L mond à plu de 5.000 rujenedes defrëntes, ulache plu de 20 à passa 50 milions o plu persones che les rejona.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Paroles scrites ie suvënz nce plu saurides da capì che paroles rujenedes. Chësc ie dantaldut vëira per la paroles che ie ries da pronunzië te na maniera tlera.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Truepa nazions ntieres rejona nglëisc zënza deficulteies y te mo de plu stac possen se aspité n cër savëi - dantaldut danter i plu jëuni.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Nmagineiete, sce te ues, n mancunian, n bostonian, n jamaican y n sydneian sentei ntëur na mëisa a cëina te n restaurant de Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ëi se la ciaculea un cun l auter de stories de si ziteies de nasciuda, cuntedes cun si azënc defrënc y tla variantes dl post.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Cumpré roba da maië ti supermarcëi ie de regula la maniera plu a bonmarcià per se nurì. Sce n ne à nia l mesun de cujiné, ie la vela te uni cajo limiteda ala roba da maië bele njenieda ca danora.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: For plu y plu supermarcëi à na sezion for plu rica de roba da maië bele njenieda ca danora. N valguni à nce n furnel a microondes o d'autri mesuns per sciaudé su la maiadives.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Te vel' stat o sort de butëighes iel almanco un n restaurant sun l post, suvënz un plutosc scëmpl y a n bon priesc.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Fé y tò pea copies de ti poliza de assegurazion y dl cuntat cun ti asseguradëur.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: N muessa mustré su la e-mail dl asseguradëur y i numeri de telefon nternaziunei per cunsulënzes/autorisazions y per damandé la refata dl dann.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Tën su n'autra copia te ti cufer y online (na e-mail mandeda a té nstës cun la njonta, o memoriseda tla "cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Canche te ves de viac cun n laptop o n tablet, mët na copia te si memoria o disch (da pudëi ruvé permez zënza internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Dati nce copies dla poliza de assegurazion/di cuntac cun l asseguradëur ai cumpanies de viac y parënc o cumpanies a cësa, che ie a una de judé.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: I auces ne ie perdrët nia agressifs, ma i se defënd, sce i sënt de vester te pericul.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Canche la jënt miena che i auces ne sibe nia periculëusc, possel vester che la ti va massa permez y se mët nstësc te pericul.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Bev la buandes alcoliches cun mesura. L alcol à n'autra fazion sun uniun y cunëscer si limit ie scialdi mpurtant.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Danter la cosses che possa suzeder tl tëmp lonch a bever de massa iel danns al fuià y nce la vercità y la mort. L pericul putenziel vën mo majer sce l vën cunsumà alcol fat te na maniera contra la lege.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Buandes alcoliches contra la lege possa avëi laite plu sortes de mpaziamënc periculëusc, leprò nce l metanol, che possa gaujé la vercità y la mort nce mé cun de pitla cuantiteies.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: I udleies possa vester miëur marcià te stac fulestieres, dantaldut te stac cun n livel de davani bas ulache i cosć per l lëur ie plu basc.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Tulëde n cunscidrazion l'idea de fé na vijita ai uedli a cësa, cis sce l'assegurazion la paia, y de ve tò pea la prescrizion per la dé ju nzaul d'auter.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Curnijes/Ëures de udleies de marches cunesciudes che n abina te de tei stac possa avëi doi problems; da una na pert possi unì fac do y dal'autra chëi che vën veramënter mpurtei possa custé mo de plu che a cësa.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: L café ie un di prudoc plu marciadei dl mond y bonamënter n abines truepa sortes tla region ulache te ies da cësa.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Purempò iel truepa manieres defrëntes de bever café sëura dut l mond, che l se paia la mueia de purvé ora.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: L canyoning (o: canyoneering) ie l jì ju te n sfundron, che ne ie no sut y no plën d'ega.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: L canyoning mët adum elemënc dl nudé, dl jì a crëp y dl saut - ma l se damanda plutosc puech alenamënt o puecia forma fisica per pudëi scumencé a l fé (n cunfront al jì a crëp, al jì sota l'ega o al jì cun i schi, per ejëmpl).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Jì sa mont ie na atività alalergia ulache n va a pe tres la natura, suvënz sun troies de jì a pe.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: La escurscions de n di va da destanzes de manco de na maila nchin a destanzes plu longes che possa unì fates te un n di.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Per na escurscion de n di do n troi saurì adroven mé puech alenamënt y uni persona che ie n pue' n forma possa se l goder.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Families cun pitli mutons pudëssa avëi de bujën de se njenië ca de plu, ma n di alalergia ie saurì nce mesun cun pops y mutons che ne va mo nia a scola.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: A livel nternaziunel iel zirca 200 urganisazions che mët a jì tours de sauté. La majera pert de chëstes lëura te na maniera ndependënta.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: L sëurastant de Global Running Tours, Go Running Tours, cunlieia te na rë desëines de fornidëures de sightrunning te cater cuntinënc.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Cun ravises ti Running Tours de Barcelona y tl Running Copenhagen de Copenhagen, iel tosc unì leprò i Running Tours Prague cun sënta a Prag y d'autri.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: L ie truepa cosses che n muessa tenì cont dan y canche n va nzaul de viac.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Canche te ves de viac, tën cont che l ie cosses che ne ie nia coche les ie a cësa. Usanzes, leges, maië, mubiltà, durmì, standard, rujeneda y nsci inant sarà n pue' autramënter da ulache te vives.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Chësc ie zeche che te muesses for tenì a mënt, per schivé delujions o povester nce na averscion contra la manieres de fé dl post.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agenzies de viac iel dal 19ejim secul incà. N'agenzia de viac ie de regula na bona opzion per n viac che va sëura la esperienzes bele fates ora n cont dla natura, dla cultura, dla rujeneda o de stac cun n livel de davani bas.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Nce sce la majera pert ie a una de tò su la majera pert dla prenutazions normales, se spezialisea truepa agenzies sun manieres particuleres de jì a pe, sun i scioldi da garat o sun la destinazions.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: L possa vester miec tò na agenzia che aposta suvënz de tei viages coche i tiei.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Cëleti ai viages che l'agenzia ie tl lëur de pité, sibe sun na plata web che te na vedrina de butëiga.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Sce te ues udëi l mond zënza spënder massa, per n bujën, per stil de vita o per ndesfideda, pona iel de plu manieres de l fé.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: De prinzip tomeles ite te doi categuries: o lauré ntan che te ies de viac o cialé de limité la spëises. Chësc articul se cunzentrea sun la segonda.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Per chëi che ie a una de sacrifiché cumodità, tëmp y planificazion per smendré la spëises nchin ju a nul, iel da ti cialé ai viages cun n budget minim.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: L cunsëi se stiza sun l prinzip che l viagiadëur ne rube nia, respete la puscion privata, ne feje nia pea pra ativiteies contra la lege, ne pëtle nia o ne sfrute nia d'autra persones per si nteresc.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: N pont de cuntrol dl'imigrazion ie de regula l prim stop canche n vën ju da n joler, da n bastimënt o da n auter mesun de trasport.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Sun n valguna ferates che va sëura i cunfins ora vëniel fat cuntroi ntan l viac, perchël fossel bon avëi for n documënt d'identità che vel canche n sënta ite sun chësta sort de ferates.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Sun ferates de nuet iel l capoferata che possa abiné adum i passaporc per ne ve descedé nia ntan l suenn.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: La registrazion ie n recuisit sëuraprò per giapé n visum. Te n valgun stac iel de bujën de registré si prejënza y de scrì su l'adres ulache n sta pra l'autoriteies dl post.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: L possa vester che l vën damandà de scrì ora n formuler pra la polizai dl post o de jì ti ufizies de imigrazion.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Te truep stac cun na tel lege saral i hotiei dl post che manejea la registrazion (damandëde do per na segura).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Te d'autri caji ti vëniel damandà la registrazion mé a chëi che ne sta nia te strutures turistiches. Nsci ie ntant sce la lege manco tlera, perchël cëla de te nfurmé danora.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: L'architetura à da nfé cun la planificazion y l frabiché de cëses. L'architetura de n post ie suvënz n'atrazion turistica per si vester.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Truep frabicac ie bëndebò biei da ti cialé y l panorama da na cësa auta o da n viere te na bona posizion possa vester propi n beludëi.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: L'architetura va sëura d'autri ciamps ora te na maniera senificativa, coche l'urbanistica, la njenieria zevila, l'ert decurativa, l'architetura per l dedite y l'architetura dla cuntreda.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Sce n tën cont de tan dalonc che i populi ie, pona ne sares nia bon de avëi na gran vita de nuet zënza jì nchin a Albuquerque o Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Purempò iel belau duc i casinò dac dant che pieta da bever y n valguni pieta nce devertimënc de luxus (dantaldut chëi majeri dlongia Albuquerque y Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Metëde a verda: i bar dla pitla ziteies ne ie nia for posć adatei per vijitadëures da oradecà.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Dantaldut à l Nuef Mexico n gran problem cun chëi che furnea cun l auto da ciocs y cun l gran numer de autisć ntussiei che ie aut daujin ai bar dla pitla ziteies.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Depënc sun parëi o crazelnamënc nia ului ie cunesciui coche graffiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Scebën che l ne ie propi nia n fenomen modern, iel bonamënter mpo trueps che l lieia ai jëuni che danejea la puscion publica y privata cun culëures a spray.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Purempò iel al didancuei artisć de graffiti recunesciui, evënc de graffiti y mures "leghei". Te chësc cuntest ti semea i depënc graffiti de plu a drëta opres d'ert che no a simboi nia da liejer.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Tré l boomerang ie na abiltà populera che truep turisć uel mparé.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Sce te ues mparé a tré n boomerang che vën de reviers te ti mans, pona cëla che te ebes n boomerang adatà per chësc.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: La majera pert di boomerang da garat tl'Australia ne vën perdrët nia de reviers. Per chëi che scumëncia iel miec ne purvé nia a tré canche l ie da vënt.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: La spëisa tradiziunela Hangi vën cujineda te na buja ciauda giaveda ite tl fonz.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: La buja vën sciaudeda cun sasc fiersc de n fuech o te vel' post iel l ciaut geotermich che sciauda i raions de terac naturalmënter.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: L hangi vën suvënz adurvà per cujiné na cëina te n stil de praté tradiziunel.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: De plu posć a Rotorua pieta l hangi geotermal, ntan che d'autri hangi possa unì ciarcëi a Christchurch, Wellington y te autri posć.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail à doi tlasses sun la ferates per passajiers te y ntëur Cape Town: MetroPlus (nce tlameda Prima Tlas) y Metro (nce tlameda Terza Tlas).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus ie plu da sté saurì y manco plën ma nce n pue' plu cër, nce sce l ie for mo plu a bonmarcià che na cherta normala dla metro t’Europa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Uni ferata à vagons sibe MetroPlus che Metro; i vagons MetroPlus ie for dala fin dla ferata, che ie plu daujin a Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Traspurté per d'autri - Ne lascëde mei vosc cufer ora dl uedl, dantaldut nia canche te traversëis cunfins nternaziunei.
eng_text: Carrying for others - Never let your bags out of your sight, especially when you are crossing international borders.

text: N pudëssa unì adurvei coche traspurtadëures de droga zënza che n se ntënd, cie che purtëssa de gran problems.
eng_text: You could find yourself being used as a drug carrier without your knowledge, which will land you in a great deal of trouble.

text: Chësc tol ite aspité tla coda, davia che cians che tofa la droga pudëssa unì adurvei te uni mumënt y zënza preavis.
eng_text: This includes waiting in line, as drug-sniffing dogs could be used at any time without notice.

text: N valgun stac à straufonghes ora de mesura stersces nce per n reat che suzed l prim iede, chëstes possa stlù ite sentënzes da jì te perjon per plu de 10 ani o la mort.
eng_text: Some countries have exceedingly draconian punishments even for first time offenses; these can include prison sentences of over 10 years or death.

text: Cufri nia custedii ie n travert per chi che ruba y possa nce tré l'atenzion dla autoriteies, che mët a verda dala manacedes de bombes.
eng_text: Unattended bags are a target for theft and can also attract attention from authorities wary of bomb threats.

text: A cësa, sotmetù a chësta espusizion costanta de germs da tlo, iel na gran puscibltà che te ies bele imun a chisc.
eng_text: At home, due to this constant exposure to the local germs, odds are very high that you're already immune to them.

text: Ma te d'autra pertes dl mond, ulache la fauna de bateries ie nueva per te, ie la puscibltà de ruvé te problems scialdi majera.
eng_text: But in other parts of the world, where the bacteriological fauna are new to you, you're far more likely to run into problems.

text: Sëuraprò crësc bateries te n tlima plu ciaut plu aslune y sëuraviv plu giut ora dl corp.
eng_text: Also, in warmer climates bacteria both grow more quickly and survive longer outside the body.

text: Nscila i sflagei de Delhi Belly, la maledizion dl faraon, la vendëta de Montezuma y si truep cumpanies.
eng_text: Thus the scourges of Delhi Belly, the Pharaoh's Curse, Montezuma's Revenge, and their many friends.

text: Coche i problems de respirazion ti raions tlimatics plu frëic, nsci vëniel ti raions tlimatics plu ciauc dant plu suvënz problems ai stentins y te truep caji iesi scialdi ncompri ma nia propi periculëusc.
eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

text: Sce viagëis per l prim iede te n paesc che ie tl lëur de se svilupé - o te na pert nueva dl mond - ne sotvalutëde nia l puscibl shock culturel.
eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

text: Truep viagiadëures cun esperienza se à lascià mpresciuné dala nuviteies di viages mundiei te paejes che se svilupea, ulache de plu pitli fatores culturei possa tumé adum aslune.
eng_text: Many a stable, capable traveler has been overcome by the newness of developing world travel, where many little cultural adjustments can add up quickly.

text: Cunscidrea dantaldut ti prim dis l'idea de sté te hotiei, de maië y de adurvé servijes cun stil y cualità uzidentela, per judé a te atlimatisé.
eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

text: Ne durmide nia sun n madroz o n madroz da suflé sun fonz te raions ulache ne cunescëis nia la fauna dl post.
eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

text: Sce jëis a sté te tënda tulëde pea na pitla branda o n'amaca per ve tenì dalonc la beches, scurpions o de tei tieres.
eng_text: If you are going to camp out, bring a camp cot or hammock to keep you away from snakes, scorpions and such.

text: Mplenide vosta cësa cun n café rich daduman y vel té da camilia per se destënder da sëira.
eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

text: Canche fajëis feries a cësa ëis dl'aurela de ve traté bën y de ve tò n valgun menuc de plu per anjenië ca zeche de particuler.
eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

text: Sce te sëntes plu venturëus, pona tole l'ucajion de druché ora o de mescedé adum vel' sort de smoothies:
eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

text: L pudëssa vester che giatëis vel buanda scëmpla che pudëis fé da gusté, pernanche jirëis de reviers te vosta routine da uni di.
eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Sce te vives te na zità cun na cultura dl bever desvaliva, va te ustaries o pubs te cuatieres ulache ne te ves scenó nia.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Per chëi che ne n'ie nia a cunescënza dl jargon dla medejina à la paroles "da nfeté" y "da taché" senificac defrënc.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Na malatia da nfeté ie una che vën gaujeda da n patogen, coche n virus, na bateria, n fonch o d'autri parassic.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Na malatia da taché ie na malatia che vën data inant saurì a sté daujin a na persona nfeteda.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Trueps guvierns pertënd dai vijitadëures che vën adalerch o dai residënc che se n va dal stat, de avëi fat la dlavea contra na lingia de malaties.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

text: Chisc recuisic possa suvënz depënder dai stac che n viagiadëur à vijità o uel vijité.
eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Un di ponc stersc de Charlotte, tla Carolina dl Nord, ie che la à na abundanza de opzions de cualità auta per la families.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Residënc de d'autra regions dà suvënz dant la bela manieres ti cunfronc dla families coche prima rejon per jì a viver iló y i vijitadëures ie suvënz dla minonga che la zità sibe bela da udëi cun i mutons.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Ti ultimi vint ani ie la cumpëida de opzions a bën di mutons a Uptown Charlotte chersciuda scialdi.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: I taxi ne vën de regula nia adurvei scialdi dala families a Charlotte, nce sce i possa vester de utl te cërta situazions.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

text: Sce l ie plu de doi passajieres vëniel damandà n suplemënt y nsci pudëssa chësta opzion vester plu cëra che chël che ie debujën.
eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: L' Antartis ie l post plu frëit dla Tiera y la ie ntëur al Pol sud.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: La vijites turistiches ie cëres, les se damanda na cërta preparazion fisica, les possa mé unì fates d'instà ( nuvëmber - fauré ) y ie n gran pert mé limitedes ala penijula, ala ijules y al Mer de Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: N pèr de milesc de cumëmbri dl personal viv tlo d'instà te n cater desëines de cuatieres che ie de regula te chisc raions; na pitla cumpëida resta nce sëura l inviern tlo.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

text: La pert dedite dl'Antartis ie n plateau arbandunà curì da 2-3 km de dlacia.
eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Uni tant fej julieres spezialisei na raida tla pert dedite, per jì a crëp o per arjonjer l Pol, che à na gran basa.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: La traverseda dl Pol Sud (o autostreda) ie na streda de 1.600 km dala stazion de McMurdo sun l Mer de Ross nchin al Pol.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: L se trata de nëif cumpata cun sfëntes mplenides ora y seniedes ite da bandieres. N possa mé furné sëuravia cun tractor spezialisei che tira lueses cun ciarburant y proviant.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Chisc ne ie nia drë flinch, nsci che la streda muessa fé na gran raida ntëur ai Crëps Transantartics per ruvé sun l plateau.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: La gauja che vën dant l plu suvënz per i nzidënc d'inviern ie l lize sun la stredes, troies da jì a pe (tretuares) y dantaldut sceles.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: N adrova almanco ciauzei cun na sola adateda. Ciauzei da d'instà ie suvënz scialdi lizi sun la dlacia o la nëif y datrai ie monce stivei da d'inviern defetëusc.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: L profil tuchëssa da vester sot assé, 5 mm (1/5 de n zol) o de plu y l material mujel assé per la temperatures frëides.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: N valgun stivei à ciodi y l ie nce njontes cun ciodi per canche l ie scialdi lize, adatedes per la gran pert di ciauzei y stivei, per l tach o per l tach y la sola.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: I tac dëssa vester basc y lerc. Sablon, giara o sel (clorid de calzium) vën suvënz trac ora sun stredes o sun troies per miuré la trazion sun streda.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Levines ne n'ie nia zeche ora dl normal; i ronesc ërc possa mé tenì su n tant de nëif y la cuantiteies sëuraprò vën ju coche levines.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: L problem ie che la nëif ie tachëusa, perchël iel de bujën de zeche per la destaché, per la fé unì ju y vel' sort de nëif che vën ju possa vester la gauja che fej unì ju l rest.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Datrai ie la gauja che fej pië via la nëif l surëdl che la sciauda, datrai vel' nevera sëuraprò, datrai d'autri avenimënc naturei, suvënz na persona.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: N tornado ie na stria dal vënt cun aria che à na prescion scialdi bassa che tira ite l'aria ntëur via y la lascia jì su.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: I generea vënc stersc (suvënz nchin a 100-200 mailes/ëura) y possa auzé su tl'aria cosses pesoces, les trajan su pea cun l tornado che se muev.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: I scumëncia sciche n rurel che vën ju da nibles di temporai y se trasfurmea te tornados canche i toca l fonz.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: I furnitëures persunei VPN (virtual private network) ie n mesun ezelënt per ti mucé sibe ala zensura politica che al filter geografich cumerziel IP.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: I ie miëures che i web proxies per de plu rejons: i desvieia dut l trafich internet, nia mé l http.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

text: Ëi pieta normalmënter na majera larghëza de banda y na miëura cualità dl servisc. I ie criptei y chësc porta pro che l ie plu rie a i spië.
eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: La firmes de media mënt regularmënter n cont de chësta ntenzion, dijan che l ie per "mpedì azions da pirac".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Veramënter ne à i codesc regiunei assolutamënter deguna fazion sun la copies contra la lege; na copia bit per bit de na dischëta va ju zënza problems ulache l uriginel va nce.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

text: La ntenzion atuela ie chëla de ti dé ala firmes n majer cuntrol sun si marcëi; la va for de fé giré i scioldi.
eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Acioche la cherdedes vënie mandedes tres internet, ne adroves nia plu na firma telefonica tl luech de residënza o ulache te ies de viac.
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: L ne vën nianca no pertendù che te es n numer lochel dl chemun te chël che te vives; te posses abiné n liam internet tres satelit ti raions salveres de Chicken, tl Alaska y crì ora n numer che dij che te ies tl'Arizona da surëdl.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Suvënz muesses cumpré n numer globel a pert che lascia pro che telefons PSTN possa te cherdé su. Da ulache l numer ie, fej ora na defrënza per la persones che te chërda su.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: App de tradutëures de tesć te tëmp reél - aplicazions che ie bones de tradujer automaticamënter tòc ntieres de n test da una na rujeneda al'autra.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: N valguna aplicazions de chësta categuria possa nce tradujer tesć te rujenedes fulestieres che ie sun tofles o d'autri ogec dl mond reél, sce l utënt raida l smartphone de vieres de chisc ogec.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: I motores de traduzion se à miurà dassënn y dà śën suvënz traduzions plu o manco drëtes (y dinrer frases nia da capì), ma l ie mpo da mëter a verda, ajache i pudëssa for mo capì dut al cuntrer.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Una dla app plu cunesciudes de chësta categuria ie Google Translate, che lascia pro de fé traduzions offline do che n à desćiarià i tesć tla rujeneda che n uel.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Se nuzé dla app de navigazion GPS sun ti smartphone possa vester l mesun plu saurì y plu cunvenient per navighé canche te ies dalonc da ti ncësa.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Chësc possa ulëi dì sparanië i scioldi che n dà scenó ora a cumpré chertes nueves per n GPS, o n aparat de navigazion GPS autonom o a nen mpresté ora un da na firma che mprësta ora auti.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Sce te ne es degun cunliamënt ai dac per ti fonin o sce l ne ie deguna rë, possa si funziunamënt vester limità o nia a despusizion.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Uni butëiga te cianton ie mplenida caoticamënter cun n grum de chertes de fonin paiedes danora che possa unì adurvedes da fonins a paiamënt o da telefons normai.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Scebën che la majera pert dla chertes ie bones de cherdé su dlonch, nen iel n valgunes che ie spezialisedes per cherdedes plu a bonmarcià te grupes de stac spezifics.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: L azes a chisc servijes suzed suvënz tres n numer de telefon zënza chëutes che possa unì cherdà su dala majera pert di fonins debant.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: La regules per la fotografia regulera vel nce per la registrazion video y mo de plu.
eng_text: Rules regarding regular photography also apply to video recording, possibly even more so.

text: Sce n ne possa nianca no fé na foto de zeche, pona ne muessen nianca no tò n cunscidrazion de tò su n video.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Sce te adroves na drona, cëla avisa danora cie che te posses tò su y ciuna autorisazions o lizënzes sëuraprò che te adroves.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Fé julé na drona dlongia n aeroport o sëura na fola de jënt ie belau for na stleta idea, nce sce l ne ie nia contra la lege te ti raion.
eng_text: Flying a drone near an airport or over a crowd is almost always a bad idea, even if it's not illegal in your area.

text: Al didancuei iel rie che i viages cun l fliegher vënie apustei diretamënter dala cumpania de jol zënza avëi fat de plu crisses dant y cunfruntà i priejes.
eng_text: Nowadays air travel is only rarely booked directly through the airline without first searching and comparing prices.

text: Datrai possa l medemo jol avëi priejes scialdi defrënc aldò dla pertes de chëles che l ie metù adum y perchël iel bon cunfrunté i resultac dla nrescida y cialé do sun la plata internet dla cumpania de jol dan apusté.
eng_text: Sometimes the same flight can have vastly differing prices at various agregators and it pays to compare search results and to also look at the website of the airline itself before booking.

text: Nce sce te ne adroves nia n visum per viages curc te vel' luech coche turist o per rejons de lëur, te l adroves n generel per jì te n luech coche studënt nternaziunel per n tëmp plu lonch che chël de n turist mé d'ucajion.
eng_text: While you may not need a visa for short visits to certain countries as a tourist or for business, going there as an international student generally requires a longer stay than going there just as a casual tourist.

text: N generel iel de bujën giapé n visum danora per sté te n stat fulestier per plu giut.
eng_text: In general, staying in any foreign country for an extended period of time will require you to obtain a visa in advance.

text: I visum per studënc à n generel d'autri recuisic y d'autra pruzedures de dumanda che i visum per turism o per afares.
eng_text: Student visas generally have different requirements and application procedures from normal tourist or business visas.

text: Per la majera pert di stac adroves na lëtra de piteda da pert dl istitut ulache te ues studië, ma nce na prova di mesuns finanzieres che ie de bujën per sustenì almanco l prim ann de ti curs.
eng_text: For most countries, you will need an offer letter from the institution you wish to study at, and also evidence of funds to support yourself for at least the first year of your course.

text: Damanda do tl istitut y nce tl ufize de imigrazion dl post ulache te ues jì a studië nfurmazions plu avisa sun i recuisic.
eng_text: Check with the institution, as well as the immigration department for the country you wish to study in for detailed requirements.

text: A cundizion che te ne ies nia n diplomat, cumporta lauré oradecà de regula l paiamënt dla chëuta sun l davani tl stat ulache te ves.
eng_text: Unless you are a diplomat, working overseas generally means that you will have to file income tax in the country you are based in.

text: La chëuta sun l davani ie strutureda autramënter ti stac defrënc y la perzentueles y la tlasses dla chëutes se muda dassënn da n stat al auter.
eng_text: Income tax is structured differently in different countries, and the tax rates and brackets vary widely from one country to another.

text: Te n valgun stac federei, coche i Stac Unii y l Canada, vën la chëuta sun l davani scudida sibe a livel federel che a livel local, perchël possa la perzentueles y la tlasses dla chëutes mudé da n raion al auter.
eng_text: In some federal countries, such as the United States and Canada, income tax is levied both at the federal level and at the local level, so the rates and brackets can vary from region to region.

text: Nce sce l cuntrol dl’imigrazion mancia de regula o ie mé na formalità canche te ruves inò a cësa, possa purempò l cuntrol dla dogana vester sfadiëus.
eng_text: While immigration check is usually absent or a formality when you arrive in your homeland, customs control can be a hassle.

text: Assegureiete che te ses cie che te posses o ne posses nia tò pea y detlarea dut chël che va sëura i limic de lege ora.
eng_text: Make sure you know what you can and cannot bring in and declare anything over the legal limits.

text: La maniera plu scëmpla per scumencé a scrì libri de viac ie de perfeziuné ti capaziteies sun na plata internet cunesciuda de blog de viac.
eng_text: The easiest way to get started in the business of travel writing is to hone your skills on an established travel blog website.

text: Do che te es mparà a formaté y a scrì tl web, posses plu inant fé ti plata internet.
eng_text: After you become comfortable with formatting and editing on the web, then later, you might create your own website.

text: Fé ulentariat ntan l viac ie na bela maniera de dé n cuntribut, ma l ne se trata nia mé de dé.
eng_text: Volunteering while travelling is a great way to make a difference but it's not just about giving.

text: Viver y fé ulentariat te n stat fulestier ie na bela maniera per mparé a cunëscer n'autra cultura, per ancunté jënt nueva, per mparé a cunëscer miec sé nstësc, per giapé na pruspetiva nueva y nchinamei per ruvé pra cumpetënzes nueves.
eng_text: Living and volunteering in a foreign country is a great way to get to know a different culture, meet new people, learn about yourself, get a sense of perspective and even gain new skills.

text: L possa nce vester na bon maniera per aumenté i mesuns finanzieres da garat per pudëi sté plu giut nzaul d'auter, ajache truep lëures de ulentariat pieta spëisa y albierch y per n valguni giapen paià per l lëur fat.
eng_text: It can also be a good way to stretch a budget to allow a longer stay somewhere since many volunteer jobs provide room and board and a few pay a small salary.

text: I Vichings se nuzova dla stredes sun l'ega russes per arjonjer l Mer fosch y l Mer caspich. N valguna pertes de chësta trasses possa mo unì nuzedes. Cëla do sce l ie de bujën de autorisazions spezieles ajache l pudëssa vester rie les giapé.
eng_text: Vikings used the Russian waterways to get to the Black Sea and Caspian Sea. Parts of these routes can still be used. Check possible need for special permits, which may be difficult to get.

text: L Canal dl Mer blanch-Mer baltich cunlieia l Mer dlacià artich cun l Mer baltich, passan per l Lech Onega, l Lech Ladoga y San Petersburg, per la majera pert sun ruves y lec.
eng_text: The White Sea–Baltic Canal connects the Arctic Ocean to the Baltic Sea, via Lake Onega, Lake Ladoga and Saint Petersburg, mostly by rivers and lakes.

text: L Lech Onega ie nce cunlià cun la Volga, perchël vala mo de jì dal Mer caspich de vieres dla Ruscia.
eng_text: Lake Onega is also connected to Volga, so coming from the Caspian Sea through Russia is still possible.

text: Pernanche te arjunjeres i porc de mer turistics sarà dut bëndebò saurì. Te ancunteres d'autri che fej autostop sun la berches y ëi te dajerà n grum de nfurmazions.
eng_text: Be assured that once you hit the marinas everything will be pretty obvious. You will meet other boat hitchhikers and they will share their information with you.

text: Perdrët messeres taché su avisc cun chëi che te pietes ti aiut, sauté ora per i porc, rujené cun la jënt che puzenea la berches, purvé a tò su cuntat cun i marineies tl bar, y n.i.
eng_text: Basically you'll be putting up notices offering your help, pacing the docks, approaching people cleaning their yachts, trying to make contact with sailors in the bar, etc.

text: Purvëde a rujené cun plu persones che la va. Do n struf ve cunescerà duc y ve dajerà cunsëies ciuna berca che va a crì zachei.
eng_text: Try to talk to as many people as possible. After a while everyone will know you and will give you hints as to which boat is looking for someone.

text: N dëssa crì ora avisa si cumpania de jol plu adurveda danter chëles tla medema lianza.
eng_text: You should choose your Frequent Flyer airline in an alliance carefully.

text: Nce sce n possa miné che l ie ntuitif tò na cumpania cun chëla che n jola l plu suvënz, dëssen savëi che i privilegs pitei ie suvënz defrënc y che n possa giapé de plu ponc ajache n jola plu suvënz pra n'autra cumpania de joi dla medema lianza.
eng_text: Although you may think it is intuitive to join the airline you fly most, you should be aware that privileges offered are often different and frequent flyer points may be more generous under a different airline in the same alliance.

text: La cumpanies de jol coche Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways y Turkish Airlines à auzà dassënn si servijes per l'Africa y pieta cunliamënc cun truepa de gran ziteies africanes a n priesc che ti fej cuncurënza a d'autra cumpanies de jol europeiches.
eng_text: Airlines such as Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways & Turkish Airlines have greatly expanded their services to Africa, and offer connections to many major African cities at competitive rates than other European airlines.

text: La Turkish Airlines à 39 destinazions te 30 stac africans dal 2014 inant.
eng_text: Turkish Airlines flies to 39 destinations in 30 African countries as of 2014.

text: Sce n à plu dl'aurela de viagë, possen paredlé la tarifa ndut per l'Africa cun chëla de n viac ntëur al mond.
eng_text: If you have additional travel time, check to see how your total fare quote to Africa compares with a round-the-world fare.

text: No te desmincë i custimënc sëuraprò per d'autri visum, per chëutes dl dejol, per trasporc a tiera y n.i. per duc i stac ora dl'Africa.
eng_text: Don't forget to add in the extra costs of additional visas, departure taxes, ground transportation, etc. for all those places outside of Africa.

text: Sce te ues julé ntëur dut l mond tl'emisfera dl sud, ie la vela di joi y dla destinazions limiteda ajache l mancia la trasses da un n ozean al auter.
eng_text: If you want to fly around the world completely in the Southern Hemisphere, the choice of flights and destinations is limited due to the lack of transoceanic routes.

text: Deguna lianza de cumpanies de jol cuer duta trëi la traversedes di ozeans tl'emisfera dl sud (y SkyTeam ne cuer deguna dla traversedes).
eng_text: No airline alliance covers all three ocean crossings in the Southern Hemisphere (and SkyTeam covers none of the crossings).

text: Ma la Star Alliance cuer dut, ora che l Pazifich sud-urientel da Santiago de Cile a Tahiti, che vën curì da LATAM Oneworld.
eng_text: However, Star Alliance covers everything except the eastern South Pacific from Santiago de Chile to Tahiti, which is a LATAM Oneworld flight.

text: Chësc jol ne ie nia la sëula opzion sce n uel lascé ora l Pazifich dl sud y la costa uzidentela dl'America dl sud. (cëla dessot)
eng_text: This flight is not the only option if you want to skip the South Pacific and the west coast of South America. (see below)

text: Tl 994 ti à la region etnica armena Nagorno-Karabakh dl Azerbaijan detlarà viera ai azeris.
eng_text: In 1994, the ethnically Armenian Nagorno-Karabakh region of Azerbaijan waged war against the Azeris.

text: Cun l aiut dl'Armenia iel unì crià na republica nueva. Ma deguna nazion - nianca no l'Armenia - l'à recunesciuda ufizialmënter.
eng_text: With Armenian backing, a new republic was created. However, no established nation - not even Armenia - officially recognizes it.

text: La descuscions diplomatiches sun la region desturba mo for la relazions danter l'Armenia y l Azerbaijan.
eng_text: Diplomatic arguments over the region continue to mar relations between Armenia and Azerbaijan.

text: L raion di canai (per olandesc: Grachtengordel) ie l raion cunesciù dl 17ejim secul ntëur ala Binnenstad de Amsterdam via.
eng_text: The Canal District (Dutch: Grachtengordel) is the famous 17th-century district surrounding the Binnenstad of Amsterdam.

text: Dut l raion ie unì detlarà pert dl'arpejon mundiela UNESCO per si valor culturel y storich unich y per l valor de si frabicac ie danter i plu auc dl stat.
eng_text: The whole district is designated as a UNESCO World Heritage Site for its unique cultural and historical value, and its property values are among the highest of the country.

text: La Cinque Terre, chël uel dì la cin tieres, tol ite i cin pitli luesc de mer de Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza y Monterosso tla region taliana Liguria.
eng_text: Cinque Terre, which means Five Lands, comprises the five small coastal villages of Riomaggiore, Manarola, Corniglia, Vernazza and Monterosso located in the Italian region of Liguria.

text: Les ie tla lista dl'arpejons mundieles UNESCO.
eng_text: They are listed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.

text: Ti seculi à la jënt fat su cun cura terasses tla cuntreda ërta y dura, bel nchin suinsom dla scolieres che pica sëura l mer ora.
eng_text: Over the centuries, people have carefully built terraces on the rugged, steep landscape right up to the cliffs that overlook the sea.

text: Si charme vën n pert dal fat che l ne ie nia da udëi raions ndustriei o artejanei. Troies, ferates y berches cunlieia i luesc y i auti ne ruva nia permez.
eng_text: Part of its charm is the lack of visible corporate development. Paths, trains and boats connect the villages, and cars cannot reach them from the outside.

text: La variantes dl franzëus che vën rujenedes tl Belgio y tla Svizra se desferenzieia n pue' dal franzëus tla Franzia, ma les se semea mpo tan da unì capides da duta les pertes.
eng_text: The varieties of French which are spoken in Belgium and Switzerland differ slightly from the French spoken in France, though they are similar enough to be mutually intelligible.

text: N particuler à l sistem de cumpedé tla pert dl Belgio y tla Svizra ulache l vën rujenà franzëus n valguna de pitla particulariteies che ie autramënter che tl franzëus rujenà tla Franzia y la pronunzia de n valguna paroles ie n pue' autramënter.
eng_text: In particular, the numbering system in French-speaking Belgium and Switzerland has some slight peculiarities that are different from the French spoken in France, and the pronunciation of some words is slightly different.

text: Purempò mpera duc i belgs y i svizeri l franzëus standard te scola, nsci possi ve ntënder nce sce adurvëis l sistem de cumpedé dl franzëus standard.
eng_text: Nevertheless, all French-speaking Belgians and Swiss would have learned standard French in school, so they would be able to understand you even if you used the standard French numbering system.

text: Te truepa pertes dl mond ie l saludé cun la man n gest de crianza per dì "hoila".
eng_text: In many parts of the world, waving is a friendly gesture, indicating "hello."

text: Ma tla Malaysia, almancul danter i abitanc ti raions da paur dla Malaysia, uelel dì "vie ca", coche canche n storj l dëit da mustré de viers dl corp, n gest che vën adurvà te cër stac dl uzidënt y che dassëssa mé unì adurvà per chël fin.
eng_text: However, in Malaysia, at least among the Malays in rural areas, it means "come over," similar to the index finger bent toward the body, a gesture which is used in certain Western countries, and should be used only for that purpose.

text: Ala medema maniera, pudëssa n viagiadëur britanich tla Spania ntënder melamënter l gest de muever la pelpa dla man de vieres de chël che saluda per tò cumià (mpede dl vieres dla persona che n saluda) y l tò su coche n gest de fé unì de reviers.
eng_text: Similarly, a British traveller in Spain may mistake a wave goodbye involving the palm facing the waver (rather than the person being waved at) as a gesture to come back.

text: La rujenedes ausilieres ie rujenedes artifizieles o fates, criedes cun l fin de scemplifiché la comunicazion danter persones che se stënta zënza a comuniché.
eng_text: Auxiliary languages are artificial or constructed languages created with the intent of facilitating communication between peoples who would otherwise have difficulty communicating.

text: Les se desferenzieia dala rujenedes franches, che ie rujenedes natureles o organiches che per vel' rejon devënta l mesun de comunicazion danter persones che rejona d'autra rujenedes.
eng_text: They are separate from lingua francas, which are natural or organic languages that become dominant for one reason or another as means of communication between speakers of other languages.

text: Ntan l majer ciaut dl di possa i turisć fé l'esperienza de se nmaginé de udëi ega (o zeche d'auter).
eng_text: In the heat of the day, travelers can experience mirages that give the illusion of water (or other things).

text: Chësc pudëssa vester periculëus sce l viagiadëur ti va do ala cossa nmagineda, sparcantan energia preziëusa y l'ega che l à mo.
eng_text: These can be dangerous if the traveler pursue the mirage, wasting precious energy and remaining water.

text: Nce l desert plu ciaut possa deventé scialdi frëit de nuet. L'ipotermia ie n pericul reél zënza guant ciaut.
eng_text: Even the hottest of deserts can become extremely cold at night. Hypothermia is a real risk without warm clothing.

text: Dantaldut d'instà muessen mëter a verda ai mustlons sce n se tol dant de passé tres n bosch tropichel.
eng_text: In summer, especially, you'll need to watch out for mosquitoes if you decide to hike through the rainforest.

text: Nce sce te ves cun l auto tres l bosch subtropichel, bastel puec secunc cun la portes daviertes ntan che te sëntes ite acioche i mustlons ruve ite te auto cun té.
eng_text: Even if you're driving through the subtropical rainforest, a few seconds with the doors open while you get inside the vehicle is enough time for mosquitoes to get in the vehicle with you.

text: L tisel di uciei possa nfeté sibe i uciei che i mamifri.
eng_text: Bird flu, or more formally avian influenza, can infect both birds and mammals.

text: Manco de mile caji ie unii documentei pra la persones, ma n valguni de chisc fova fatai.
eng_text: Fewer than a thousand cases have ever been reported in humans, but some of them have been fatal.

text: Al plu fovel persones che lëura cun pulam, ma n cër pericul iel nce per i usservadëures de uciei.
eng_text: Most have involved people who work with poultry, but there is also some risk to birdwatchers.

text: Tipics per la Norvegia ie i fiordesc ërc y la valedes che ora de nia devënta na planadura alauta plu o manco valiva.
eng_text: Typical for Norway are steep fjords and valleys that suddenly give way to a high, more or less even plateau.

text: Chësta planadures alauta vën suvënz tlamedes "vidde" che uel dì lerch, daviert y zënza lëns, na destenduda zënza cunfins.
eng_text: These plateaus are often referred to as "vidde" meaning a wide, open treeless space, a boundless expanse.

text: A Rogaland y a Agder vëni de regula tlamei "hei" che uel dì n paluch zënza lëns y suvënz curì da burvel.
eng_text: In Rogaland and Agder they are usually called "hei" meaning a treeless moorland often covered in heather.

text: I dlacieres ne ie nia stabii, ma i sbriscia ju per l crëp. Chësc gaujea sfëntes o bujes sëura chëles che n possa passé via cun puenc de nëif.
eng_text: The glaciers are not stable, but flow down the mountain. This will cause cracks, crevasses, which may be obscured by snow bridges.

text: I parëies y i plafons dla ciavernes tla dlacia possa tumé ite y la sfëntes possa se stlù.
eng_text: The walls and roofs of ice caves can collapse and cracks can get closed.

text: Dai ëures di dlacieres se destaca de gran purons che toma ju y povester sbalza o berdola dalonc dal ëur.
eng_text: At the edge of glaciers huge blocks break loose, fall down and perhaps jump or roll farther from the edge.

text: La sajon turistica ti luesc da coi arjonj de regula la prejënzes plu autes ntan l instà indian.
eng_text: The tourist season for the hill stations generally peaks during the Indian summer.

text: Ma i à n'autra belëza y n auter charme ntan l inviern, i truep luesc da coi ie curii da truepa nëif y pieta ativiteies coche jì cun i schi o cun la brëia.
eng_text: However, they have a different kind of beauty and charm during winter, with many hill stations receiving healthy amounts of snow and offering activities such as skiing and snowboarding.

text: Mé puecia cumpanies de jol pieta mo sustënies n cajo de mort, te na forma de na pitla arbasseda dl priesc per n jol al ultim menut per jì a na supeltura.
eng_text: Only a few airlines still offer bereavement fares, which slightly discount the cost of last-minute funeral travel.

text: La cumpanies de jol che pieta chësc ie Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa per joi dai Stac Unii o dal Canada y WestJet.
eng_text: Airlines that offer these include Air Canada, Delta Air Lines, Lufthansa for flights originating from the U.S. or Canada, and WestJet.

text: Te uni cajo muessen apusté cherdan su diretamënter la cumpania de jol.
eng_text: In all cases, you must book by phone directly with the airline.
